# swc_ecma_utils - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/

## Re-exports[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#reexports)

- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Bool](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as BoolType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Null](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as NullType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Num](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as NumberType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Obj](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as ObjectType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Str](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as StringType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Symbol](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as SymbolType;
- `pub use self::value::Type::`- [Undefined](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Type.html)as UndefinedType;
- `pub use self::value::Value::`- [Known](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Value.html);
- `pub use self::value::Value::`- [Unknown](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Value.html);
- `pub use self::Purity::`- [MayBeImpure](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Purity.html);
- `pub use self::Purity::`- [Pure](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/enum.Purity.html);

## Macros[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#macros)

- [member_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/macro.member_expr.html)- expr
- Creates a member expression.
- [private_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/macro.private_ident.html)- ident
- Shortcut for `quote_ident!(span.apply_mark(Mark::fresh(Mark::root())), s)`
- [quote_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/macro.quote_expr.html)- expr
- [quote_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/macro.quote_ident.html)- ident
- As we have multiple identifier types, the expected usage is
`quote_ident!("foo").into()`.
- [quote_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/macro.quote_str.html)- str

## Structs[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structs)

- [Arguments](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.ArgumentsFinder.html)- Finder
- [Binding](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.BindingCollector.html)- Collector
- [Binding](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.BindingIdentifierVisitor.html)- Identifier - Visitor
- Finds all **binding**idents of variables.
- [Destructuring](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.DestructuringFinder.html)- Finder
- Finds all **binding**idents of variables.
- [Drop](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.DropSpan.html)- Span
- [ExprCtx](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.ExprCtx.html)
- [Hoister](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.Hoister.html)
- [Ident](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.IdentRefFinder.html)- RefFinder
- [Ident](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.IdentRenamer.html)- Renamer
- Replacer for [Id] => ]Id]
- [Ident](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.IdentReplacer.html)- Replacer
- [Ident](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.IdentUsageFinder.html)- Usage - Finder
- Finds usage of `ident`
- [Literal](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.LiteralVisitor.html)- Visitor
- [Node](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.NodeIgnoringSpan.html)- Ignoring - Span
- A newtype that will ignore Span while doing `eq`or`hash`.
- [RefRewriter](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.RefRewriter.html)
- Replace `foo`with`bar`or`bar.baz`
- [Remapper](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/struct.Remapper.html)
- Variable remapper

## Functions[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#functions)

- [alias_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.alias_ident_for.html)- ident_ - for
- Used to determine super_class_ident
- [alias_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.alias_ident_for_simple_assign_tatget.html)- ident_ - for_ - simple_ - assign_ - tatget
- Used to determine super_class_ident
- [alias_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.alias_if_required.html)- if_ - required
- Returns `(ident, aliased)`
- [calc_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.calc_literal_cost.html)- literal_ - cost
- [class_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.class_has_side_effect.html)- has_ - side_ - effect
- [collect_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.collect_decls.html)- decls
- Collects binding identifiers.
- [collect_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.collect_decls_with_ctxt.html)- decls_ - with_ - ctxt
- Collects binding identifiers, but only if it has a context which is
identical to `ctxt`.
- [contains_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.contains_arguments.html)- arguments
- [contains_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.contains_ident_ref.html)- ident_ - ref
- [contains_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.contains_this_expr.html)- this_ - expr
- This does not recurse into a function if `this`is changed by it.
- [contains_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.contains_top_level_await.html)- top_ - level_ - await
- [default_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.default_constructor_with_span.html)- constructor_ - with_ - span
- `super_call_span`should be the span of the class definition Use value of [- `Class::span`].
- [drop_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.drop_span.html)- span
- [extract_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.extract_var_ids.html)- var_ - ids
- Extracts hoisted variables
- [find_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.find_pat_ids.html)- pat_ - ids
- Finds all **binding**idents of`node`.
- [for_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.for_each_binding_ident.html)- each_ - binding_ - ident
- Finds all **binding**idents of`node`.**Any nested identifiers in expressions are ignored**.
- [has_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.has_rest_pat.html)- rest_ - pat
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_literal.html)- literal
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_maybe_branch_directive.html)- maybe_ - branch_ - directive
- If the stmt is maybe a directive like `"use strict";`
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_rest_arguments.html)- rest_ - arguments
- Check if `e`is`...arguments`
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_simple_pure_expr.html)- simple_ - pure_ - expr
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_simple_pure_member_expr.html)- simple_ - pure_ - member_ - expr
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_valid_ident.html)- valid_ - ident
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_valid_prop_ident.html)- valid_ - prop_ - ident
- [num_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.num_from_str.html)- from_ - str
- [opt_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.opt_chain_test.html)- chain_ - test
- [prepend_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prepend_stmt.html)- stmt
- inject `branch`after directives
- [prepend_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prepend_stmts.html)- stmts
- inject `stmts`after directives
- [prop_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prop_name_eq.html)- name_ - eq
- [prop_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prop_name_to_expr.html)- name_ - to_ - expr
- [prop_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prop_name_to_expr_value.html)- name_ - to_ - expr_ - value
- Similar to `prop_name_to_expr`, but used for value position.
- [prop_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.prop_name_to_member_prop.html)- name_ - to_ - member_ - prop
- [replace_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.replace_ident.html)- ident
- Replace all `from`in`expr`with`to`.
- [to_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.to_int32.html)- int32
- Cast to javascript’s int32

[143](#143)impl Visit for IdentRefFinder<'_> {
[144](#144)    noop_visit_type!();
[145](#145)
[146](#146)    fn visit_expr(&mut self, e: &Expr) {
[147](#147)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[148](#148)
[149](#149)        match *e {
[150](#150)            Expr::Ident(ref i) if i.ctxt == self.ident.ctxt && i.sym == self.ident.sym => {

[153](#153)            _ => {}
[154](#154)        }

[168](#168)pub struct ArgumentsFinder {
[169](#169)    found: bool,
[170](#170)}
[171](#171)
[172](#172)impl Visit for ArgumentsFinder {
[173](#173)    noop_visit_type!();
[174](#174)
[175](#175)    fn visit_constructor(&mut self, _: &Constructor) {}
[177](#177)
[178](#178)    fn visit_expr(&mut self, e: &Expr) {
[179](#179)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[180](#180)
[181](#181)        if e.is_ident_ref_to("arguments") {
[182](#182)            self.found = true;
[183](#183)        }
[184](#184)    }
[185](#185)
[186](#186)    fn visit_function(&mut self, _: &Function) {}
[188](#188)
[189](#189)    fn visit_prop(&mut self, n: &Prop) {
[190](#190)        n.visit_children_with(self);
[191](#191)
[192](#192)        if let Prop::Shorthand(i) = n {
[193](#193)            if &*i.sym == "arguments" {
[194](#194)                self.found = true;
[195](#195)            }
[196](#196)        }
[197](#197)    }

[366](#366)impl<S> StmtLikeInjector<S> for Vec<S>
[367](#367)where
[368](#368)    S: StmtLike,
[369](#369){
[370](#370)    fn prepend_stmt(&mut self, insert_with: S) {
[372](#372)        let directive_pos = self
[373](#373)            .iter()
[374](#374)            .position(|stmt| !stmt.as_stmt().is_some_and(is_maybe_branch_directive))
[375](#375)            .unwrap_or(self.len());
[376](#376)
[377](#377)        self.insert(directive_pos, insert_with);
[378](#378)    }
[379](#379)
[380](#380)    fn prepend_stmts<I>(&mut self, insert_with: I)
[382](#382)    where
[383](#383)        I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,
[384](#384)    {
[385](#385)        let directive_pos = self
[386](#386)            .iter()
[387](#387)            .position(|stmt| !stmt.as_stmt().is_some_and(is_maybe_branch_directive))
[388](#388)            .unwrap_or(self.len());
[389](#389)
[390](#390)        self.splice(directive_pos..directive_pos, insert_with);
[391](#391)    }

[451](#451)pub trait StmtExt {
[452](#452)    fn as_stmt(&self) -> &Stmt;
[453](#453)
[454](#454)    fn extract_var_ids(&self) -> Vec<Ident> {
[456](#456)        extract_var_ids(self.as_stmt())
[457](#457)    }
[458](#458)
[459](#459)    fn extract_var_ids_as_var(&self) -> Option<VarDecl> {
[460](#460)        let ids = self.extract_var_ids();
[461](#461)        if ids.is_empty() {
[462](#462)            return None;
[463](#463)        }
[464](#464)
[465](#465)        Some(VarDecl {
[466](#466)            kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[467](#467)            decls: ids
[468](#468)                .into_iter()
[469](#469)                .map(|i| VarDeclarator {
[470](#470)                    span: i.span,
[471](#471)                    name: i.into(),
[472](#472)                    init: None,
[473](#473)                    definite: false,
[474](#474)                })
[475](#475)                .collect(),
[476](#476)            ..Default::default()
[477](#477)        })
[478](#478)    }
[479](#479)
[480](#480)    fn terminates(&self) -> bool {
[482](#482)        fn terminates_many(
[483](#483)            stmts: &[Stmt],
[484](#484)            in_switch: bool,
[485](#485)            allow_break: bool,
[486](#486)            allow_throw: bool,
[487](#487)        ) -> Result<bool, ()> {
[488](#488)            stmts
[489](#489)                .iter()
[490](#490)                .rev()
[491](#491)                .map(|s| terminates(s, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw))
[492](#492)                .try_fold(false, |acc, x| x.map(|v| acc || v))
[493](#493)        }
[494](#494)
[495](#495)        fn terminates(
[496](#496)            stmt: &Stmt,
[497](#497)            in_switch: bool,
[498](#498)            allow_break: bool,
[499](#499)            allow_throw: bool,
[500](#500)        ) -> Result<bool, ()> {
[501](#501)            Ok(match stmt {
[502](#502)                Stmt::Break(_) => {
[503](#503)                    if in_switch {
[504](#504)                        return Err(());
[521](#521)                    } else {
[522](#522)                        allow_break
[523](#523)                    }
[524](#524)                }
[525](#525)                Stmt::Throw(_) => allow_throw,
[526](#526)                Stmt::Continue(_) | Stmt::Return(_) => true,
[527](#527)                Stmt::Block(block) => {
[528](#528)                    terminates_many(&block.stmts, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?
[529](#529)                }
[530](#530)                Stmt::If(IfStmt { cons, alt, .. }) => {
[531](#531)                    if let Some(alt) = alt {
[532](#532)                        terminates(cons, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?
[533](#533)                            && terminates(alt, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?
[534](#534)                    } else {
[535](#535)                        terminates(cons, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?;
[536](#536)
[537](#537)                        false
[538](#538)                    }
[539](#539)                }
[540](#540)                Stmt::Switch(s) => {
[541](#541)                    let mut has_default = false;
[542](#542)                    let mut has_non_empty_terminates = false;
[543](#543)
[544](#544)                    for case in &s.cases {
[545](#545)                        if case.test.is_none() {
[546](#546)                            has_default = true
[547](#547)                        }
[548](#548)
[549](#549)                        if !case.cons.is_empty() {
[550](#550)                            let t = terminates_many(&case.cons, true, false, allow_throw)
[551](#551)                                .unwrap_or(false);
[552](#552)
[553](#553)                            if t {
[554](#554)                                has_non_empty_terminates = true
[555](#555)                            } else {
[556](#556)                                return Ok(false);
[557](#557)                            }
[558](#558)                        }
[559](#559)                    }
[560](#560)
[561](#561)                    has_default && has_non_empty_terminates
[562](#562)                }
[563](#563)                Stmt::Try(t) => {
[564](#564)                    if let Some(h) = &t.handler {
[565](#565)                        terminates_many(&t.block.stmts, in_switch, allow_break, false)?
[566](#566)                            && terminates_many(&h.body.stmts, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?
[567](#567)                    } else {
[568](#568)                        terminates_many(&t.block.stmts, in_switch, allow_break, allow_throw)?
[569](#569)                    }
[570](#570)                }
[571](#571)                _ => false,
[572](#572)            })
[573](#573)        }
[574](#574)
[575](#575)        terminates(self.as_stmt(), false, true, true) == Ok(true)
[576](#576)    }
[577](#577)
[578](#578)    fn may_have_side_effects(&self, ctx: ExprCtx) -> bool {
[579](#579)        fn may_have_side_effects(stmt: &Stmt, ctx: ExprCtx) -> bool {
[580](#580)            match stmt {
[581](#581)                Stmt::Block(block_stmt) => block_stmt
[582](#582)                    .stmts
[583](#583)                    .iter()
[584](#584)                    .any(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(ctx)),
[585](#585)                Stmt::Empty(_) => false,
[586](#586)                Stmt::Labeled(labeled_stmt) => labeled_stmt.body.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[587](#587)                Stmt::If(if_stmt) => {
[588](#588)                    if_stmt.test.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[589](#589)                        || if_stmt.cons.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[590](#590)                        || if_stmt
[591](#591)                            .alt
[592](#592)                            .as_ref()
[593](#593)                            .is_some_and(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[594](#594)                }
[595](#595)                Stmt::Switch(switch_stmt) => {
[596](#596)                    switch_stmt.discriminant.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[597](#597)                        || switch_stmt.cases.iter().any(|case| {
[598](#598)                            case.test
[599](#599)                                .as_ref()
[600](#600)                                .is_some_and(|expr| expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[601](#601)                                || case.cons.iter().any(|con| con.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[602](#602)                        })
[603](#603)                }
[604](#604)                Stmt::Try(try_stmt) => {
[605](#605)                    try_stmt
[606](#606)                        .block
[607](#607)                        .stmts
[608](#608)                        .iter()
[609](#609)                        .any(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[610](#610)                        || try_stmt.handler.as_ref().is_some_and(|handler| {
[611](#611)                            handler
[612](#612)                                .body
[613](#613)                                .stmts
[614](#614)                                .iter()
[615](#615)                                .any(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[616](#616)                        })
[617](#617)                        || try_stmt.finalizer.as_ref().is_some_and(|finalizer| {
[618](#618)                            finalizer
[619](#619)                                .stmts
[620](#620)                                .iter()
[621](#621)                                .any(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[622](#622)                        })
[623](#623)                }
[624](#624)                Stmt::Decl(decl) => match decl {
[625](#625)                    Decl::Class(class_decl) => class_has_side_effect(ctx, &class_decl.class),
[626](#626)                    Decl::Fn(_) => !ctx.in_strict,
[627](#627)                    Decl::Var(var_decl) => var_decl.kind == VarDeclKind::Var,
[628](#628)                    _ => false,
[629](#629)                },
[630](#630)                Stmt::Expr(expr_stmt) => expr_stmt.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[631](#631)                _ => true,
[632](#632)            }
[633](#633)        }
[634](#634)
[635](#635)        may_have_side_effects(self.as_stmt(), ctx)
[636](#636)    }
[637](#637)}
[638](#638)
[639](#639)impl StmtExt for Stmt {
[640](#640)    fn as_stmt(&self) -> &Stmt {
[641](#641)        self
[642](#642)    }
[643](#643)}
[644](#644)
[645](#645)impl StmtExt for Box<Stmt> {
[646](#646)    fn as_stmt(&self) -> &Stmt {
[647](#647)        self
[648](#648)    }

[651](#651)pub struct Hoister {
[652](#652)    vars: Vec<Ident>,
[653](#653)}
[654](#654)
[655](#655)impl Visit for Hoister {
[656](#656)    noop_visit_type!();
[657](#657)
[658](#658)    fn visit_arrow_expr(&mut self, _: &ArrowExpr) {}
[659](#659)
[660](#660)    fn visit_assign_expr(&mut self, node: &AssignExpr) {
[661](#661)        node.right.visit_children_with(self);
[662](#662)    }
[663](#663)
[664](#664)    fn visit_assign_pat_prop(&mut self, node: &AssignPatProp) {
[665](#665)        node.value.visit_with(self);
[666](#666)
[667](#667)        self.vars.push(node.key.clone().into());
[668](#668)    }
[669](#669)
[670](#670)    fn visit_constructor(&mut self, _: &Constructor) {}
[671](#671)
[672](#672)    fn visit_fn_decl(&mut self, f: &FnDecl) {
[673](#673)        self.vars.push(f.ident.clone());
[674](#674)    }
[675](#675)
[676](#676)    fn visit_function(&mut self, _: &Function) {}
[677](#677)
[678](#678)    fn visit_getter_prop(&mut self, _: &GetterProp) {}
[679](#679)
[680](#680)    fn visit_pat(&mut self, p: &Pat) {
[681](#681)        p.visit_children_with(self);
[682](#682)
[683](#683)        if let Pat::Ident(ref i) = *p {
[684](#684)            self.vars.push(i.clone().into())
[685](#685)        }
[686](#686)    }
[687](#687)
[688](#688)    fn visit_setter_prop(&mut self, _: &SetterProp) {}
[689](#689)
[690](#690)    fn visit_var_decl(&mut self, v: &VarDecl) {
[691](#691)        if v.kind != VarDeclKind::Var {
[692](#692)            return;
[693](#693)        }
[694](#694)
[695](#695)        v.visit_children_with(self)
[696](#696)    }

[840](#840)pub fn class_has_side_effect(expr_ctx: ExprCtx, c: &Class) -> bool {
[841](#841)    if let Some(e) = &c.super_class {
[842](#842)        if e.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[843](#843)            return true;
[844](#844)        }
[845](#845)    }
[846](#846)
[847](#847)    for m in &c.body {
[848](#848)        match m {
[849](#849)            ClassMember::Method(p) => {
[850](#850)                if let PropName::Computed(key) = &p.key {
[851](#851)                    if key.expr.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[852](#852)                        return true;
[853](#853)                    }
[854](#854)                }
[855](#855)            }
[856](#856)
[857](#857)            ClassMember::ClassProp(p) => {
[858](#858)                if let PropName::Computed(key) = &p.key {
[859](#859)                    if key.expr.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[860](#860)                        return true;
[861](#861)                    }
[862](#862)                }
[863](#863)
[864](#864)                if let Some(v) = &p.value {
[865](#865)                    if v.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[866](#866)                        return true;
[867](#867)                    }
[868](#868)                }
[869](#869)            }
[870](#870)            ClassMember::PrivateProp(p) => {
[871](#871)                if let Some(v) = &p.value {
[872](#872)                    if v.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx) {
[873](#873)                        return true;
[874](#874)                    }
[875](#875)                }
[876](#876)            }
[877](#877)            ClassMember::StaticBlock(s) => {
[878](#878)                if s.body
[879](#879)                    .stmts
[880](#880)                    .iter()
[881](#881)                    .any(|stmt| stmt.may_have_side_effects(expr_ctx))
[882](#882)                {
[883](#883)                    return true;
[884](#884)                }
[885](#885)            }
[886](#886)            _ => {}
[887](#887)        }
[888](#888)    }
[889](#889)
[890](#890)    false
[891](#891)}

[894](#894)    if lt == rt {
[895](#895)        return lt;

[900](#900)fn may_be_str(ty: Value<Type>) -> bool {
[902](#902)    match ty {
[903](#903)        Known(BoolType) | Known(NullType) | Known(NumberType) | Known(UndefinedType) => false,
[904](#904)        Known(ObjectType) | Known(StringType) | Unknown => true,
[905](#905)        Known(SymbolType) => true,
[907](#907)    }

[909](#909)
[910](#910)pub fn num_from_str(s: &str) -> Value<f64> {
[911](#911)    if s.contains('\u{000b}') {
[912](#912)        return Unknown;
[913](#913)    }
[914](#914)
[915](#915)    let s = s.trim();
[916](#916)
[917](#917)    if s.is_empty() {
[918](#918)        return Known(0.0);
[919](#919)    }
[920](#920)
[921](#921)    if s.len() >= 2 {
[922](#922)        match &s.as_bytes()[..2] {
[923](#923)            b"0x" | b"0X" => {
[924](#924)                return match u64::from_str_radix(&s[2..], 16) {
[925](#925)                    Ok(n) => Known(n as f64),
[926](#926)                    Err(_) => Known(f64::NAN),
[927](#927)                }
[928](#928)            }
[929](#929)            b"0o" | b"0O" => {
[930](#930)                return match u64::from_str_radix(&s[2..], 8) {
[931](#931)                    Ok(n) => Known(n as f64),
[932](#932)                    Err(_) => Known(f64::NAN),
[933](#933)                };
[934](#934)            }
[935](#935)            b"0b" | b"0B" => {
[936](#936)                return match u64::from_str_radix(&s[2..], 2) {
[937](#937)                    Ok(n) => Known(n as f64),
[938](#938)                    Err(_) => Known(f64::NAN),
[939](#939)                };
[940](#940)            }
[941](#941)            _ => {}
[942](#942)        }
[943](#943)    }
[944](#944)
[945](#945)    if (s.starts_with('-') || s.starts_with('+'))
[946](#946)        && (s[1..].starts_with("0x") || s[1..].starts_with("0X"))
[947](#947)    {
[948](#948)        return Unknown;
[950](#950)    }
[951](#951)
[952](#952)    match s {
[955](#955)        "infinity" | "+infinity" | "-infinity" => return Unknown,
[956](#956)        _ => {}
[957](#957)    }
[958](#958)
[959](#959)    Known(s.parse().ok().unwrap_or(f64::NAN))
[960](#960)}

[1001](#1001)pub fn to_int32(d: f64) -> i32 {
[1003](#1003)    let id = d as i32;
[1004](#1004)    if id as f64 == d {
[1005](#1005)        return id;
[1007](#1007)    }
[1008](#1008)
[1009](#1009)    if d.is_nan() || d.is_infinite() {
[1010](#1010)        return 0;
[1011](#1011)    }
[1012](#1012)
[1013](#1013)    let d = if d >= 0.0 { d.floor() } else { d.ceil() };
[1014](#1014)
[1015](#1015)    const TWO32: f64 = 4_294_967_296.0;
[1016](#1016)    let d = d % TWO32;
[1017](#1017)    let l = d as i64;
[1020](#1020)    l as i32

[1070](#1070)#[inline(never)]
[1071](#1071)pub fn calc_literal_cost<T>(e: &T, allow_non_json_value: bool) -> (bool, usize)
[1072](#1072)where
[1073](#1073)    T: VisitWith<LiteralVisitor>,
[1074](#1074){
[1075](#1075)    let mut v = LiteralVisitor {
[1076](#1076)        is_lit: true,
[1077](#1077)        cost: 0,
[1078](#1078)        allow_non_json_value,
[1079](#1079)    };
[1080](#1080)    e.visit_with(&mut v);
[1081](#1081)
[1082](#1082)    (v.is_lit, v.cost)
[1083](#1083)}
[1084](#1084)
[1085](#1085)pub struct LiteralVisitor {
[1086](#1086)    is_lit: bool,
[1087](#1087)    cost: usize,
[1088](#1088)    allow_non_json_value: bool,
[1089](#1089)}
[1090](#1090)
[1091](#1091)impl Visit for LiteralVisitor {
[1092](#1092)    noop_visit_type!();
[1093](#1093)
[1094](#1094)    fn visit_array_lit(&mut self, e: &ArrayLit) {
[1095](#1095)        if !self.is_lit {
[1096](#1096)            return;
[1097](#1097)        }
[1098](#1098)
[1099](#1099)        self.cost += 2 + e.elems.len();
[1100](#1100)
[1101](#1101)        e.visit_children_with(self);
[1102](#1102)
[1103](#1103)        for elem in &e.elems {
[1104](#1104)            if !self.allow_non_json_value && elem.is_none() {
[1105](#1105)                self.is_lit = false;
[1106](#1106)            }
[1107](#1107)        }
[1108](#1108)    }
[1109](#1109)
[1110](#1110)    fn visit_arrow_expr(&mut self, _: &ArrowExpr) {
[1111](#1111)        self.is_lit = false
[1112](#1112)    }
[1113](#1113)
[1114](#1114)    fn visit_assign_expr(&mut self, _: &AssignExpr) {
[1115](#1115)        self.is_lit = false;
[1116](#1116)    }
[1117](#1117)
[1118](#1118)    fn visit_await_expr(&mut self, _: &AwaitExpr) {
[1119](#1119)        self.is_lit = false
[1120](#1120)    }
[1121](#1121)
[1122](#1122)    fn visit_bin_expr(&mut self, _: &BinExpr) {
[1123](#1123)        self.is_lit = false
[1124](#1124)    }
[1125](#1125)

[1135](#1135)        self.is_lit = false;
[1136](#1136)    }
[1137](#1137)
[1138](#1138)    fn visit_expr(&mut self, e: &Expr) {
[1139](#1139)        if !self.is_lit {
[1140](#1140)            return;
[1141](#1141)        }
[1142](#1142)
[1143](#1143)        match *e {
[1144](#1144)            Expr::Ident(..) | Expr::Lit(Lit::Regex(..)) => self.is_lit = false,
[1145](#1145)            Expr::Tpl(ref tpl) if !tpl.exprs.is_empty() => self.is_lit = false,
[1146](#1146)            _ => e.visit_children_with(self),
[1147](#1147)        }
[1148](#1148)    }
[1149](#1149)
[1150](#1150)    fn visit_fn_expr(&mut self, _: &FnExpr) {
[1151](#1151)        self.is_lit = false;
[1152](#1152)    }
[1153](#1153)

[1156](#1156)    }

[1158](#1158)    fn visit_member_expr(&mut self, m: &MemberExpr) {
[1159](#1159)        if m.obj.is_ident_ref_to("Symbol") {
[1160](#1160)            return;
[1161](#1161)        }
[1162](#1162)
[1163](#1163)        self.is_lit = false;
[1164](#1164)    }

[1176](#1176)            self.is_lit = false;
[1177](#1177)        }
[1178](#1178)    }

[1188](#1188)    fn visit_prop(&mut self, p: &Prop) {
[1189](#1189)        if !self.is_lit {
[1190](#1190)            return;
[1191](#1191)        }
[1192](#1192)
[1193](#1193)        p.visit_children_with(self);
[1194](#1194)
[1195](#1195)        match p {
[1196](#1196)            Prop::KeyValue(..) => {
[1197](#1197)                self.cost += 1;
[1198](#1198)            }
[1199](#1199)            _ => self.is_lit = false,
[1200](#1200)        }
[1201](#1201)    }
[1202](#1202)
[1203](#1203)    fn visit_prop_name(&mut self, node: &PropName) {
[1204](#1204)        if !self.is_lit {
[1205](#1205)            return;
[1206](#1206)        }
[1207](#1207)
[1208](#1208)        node.visit_children_with(self);
[1209](#1209)
[1210](#1210)        match node {
[1211](#1211)            PropName::Str(ref s) => self.cost += 2 + s.value.len(),
[1212](#1212)            PropName::Ident(ref id) => self.cost += 2 + id.sym.len(),
[1213](#1213)            PropName::Num(..) => {
[1214](#1214)                self.cost += 5;
[1216](#1216)            }
[1217](#1217)            PropName::BigInt(_) => self.is_lit = false,
[1218](#1218)            PropName::Computed(..) => self.is_lit = false,
[1219](#1219)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1220](#1220)            _ => (),
[1221](#1221)        }
[1222](#1222)    }

[1261](#1261)pub fn is_simple_pure_expr(expr: &Expr, pure_getters: bool) -> bool {
[1262](#1262)    match expr {
[1263](#1263)        Expr::Ident(..) | Expr::This(..) | Expr::Lit(..) => true,
[1264](#1264)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1265](#1265)            op: op!("void") | op!("!"),
[1266](#1266)            arg,
[1267](#1267)            ..
[1268](#1268)        }) => is_simple_pure_expr(arg, pure_getters),
[1269](#1269)        Expr::Member(m) if pure_getters => is_simple_pure_member_expr(m, pure_getters),
[1270](#1270)        _ => false,
[1271](#1271)    }
[1272](#1272)}
[1273](#1273)
[1274](#1274)pub fn is_simple_pure_member_expr(m: &MemberExpr, pure_getters: bool) -> bool {
[1275](#1275)    match &m.prop {
[1276](#1276)        MemberProp::Ident(..) | MemberProp::PrivateName(..) => {
[1277](#1277)            is_simple_pure_expr(&m.obj, pure_getters)
[1278](#1278)        }
[1279](#1279)        MemberProp::Computed(c) => {
[1280](#1280)            is_simple_pure_expr(&c.expr, pure_getters) && is_simple_pure_expr(&m.obj, pure_getters)
[1281](#1281)        }
[1282](#1282)        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1283](#1283)        _ => false,
[1284](#1284)    }
[1285](#1285)}
[1286](#1286)
[1287](#1287)fn sym_for_expr(expr: &Expr) -> Option<String> {
[1288](#1288)    match expr {
[1289](#1289)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(s)) => s.value.as_str().map(ToString::to_string),
[1290](#1290)        Expr::This(_) => Some("this".to_string()),
[1291](#1291)
[1292](#1292)        Expr::Ident(ident)
[1293](#1293)        | Expr::Fn(FnExpr {
[1294](#1294)            ident: Some(ident), ..
[1295](#1295)        })
[1296](#1296)        | Expr::Class(ClassExpr {
[1297](#1297)            ident: Some(ident), ..
[1298](#1298)        }) => Some(ident.sym.to_string()),
[1299](#1299)
[1300](#1300)        Expr::OptChain(OptChainExpr { base, .. }) => match &**base {
[1301](#1301)            OptChainBase::Call(OptCall { callee: expr, .. }) => sym_for_expr(expr),
[1302](#1302)            OptChainBase::Member(MemberExpr {
[1303](#1303)                prop: MemberProp::Ident(ident),
[1304](#1304)                obj,
[1305](#1305)                ..
[1306](#1306)            }) => Some(format!(
[1307](#1307)                "{}_{}",
[1308](#1308)                sym_for_expr(obj).unwrap_or_default(),
[1309](#1309)                ident.sym
[1310](#1310)            )),
[1311](#1311)
[1312](#1312)            OptChainBase::Member(MemberExpr {
[1313](#1313)                prop: MemberProp::Computed(ComputedPropName { expr, .. }),
[1314](#1314)                obj,
[1315](#1315)                ..
[1316](#1316)            }) => Some(format!(
[1317](#1317)                "{}_{}",
[1318](#1318)                sym_for_expr(obj).unwrap_or_default(),
[1319](#1319)                sym_for_expr(expr).unwrap_or_default()
[1320](#1320)            )),
[1321](#1321)            _ => None,
[1322](#1322)        },
[1323](#1323)        Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[1324](#1324)            callee: Callee::Expr(expr),
[1325](#1325)            ..
[1326](#1326)        }) => sym_for_expr(expr),
[1327](#1327)
[1328](#1328)        Expr::SuperProp(SuperPropExpr {
[1329](#1329)            prop: SuperProp::Ident(ident),
[1330](#1330)            ..
[1331](#1331)        }) => Some(format!("super_{}", ident.sym)),
[1332](#1332)
[1333](#1333)        Expr::SuperProp(SuperPropExpr {
[1334](#1334)            prop: SuperProp::Computed(ComputedPropName { expr, .. }),
[1335](#1335)            ..
[1336](#1336)        }) => Some(format!("super_{}", sym_for_expr(expr).unwrap_or_default())),
[1337](#1337)
[1338](#1338)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[1339](#1339)            prop: MemberProp::Ident(ident),
[1340](#1340)            obj,
[1341](#1341)            ..
[1342](#1342)        }) => Some(format!(
[1343](#1343)            "{}_{}",
[1344](#1344)            sym_for_expr(obj).unwrap_or_default(),
[1345](#1345)            ident.sym
[1346](#1346)        )),
[1347](#1347)
[1348](#1348)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[1349](#1349)            prop: MemberProp::Computed(ComputedPropName { expr, .. }),
[1350](#1350)            obj,
[1351](#1351)            ..
[1352](#1352)        }) => Some(format!(
[1353](#1353)            "{}_{}",
[1354](#1354)            sym_for_expr(obj).unwrap_or_default(),
[1355](#1355)            sym_for_expr(expr).unwrap_or_default()
[1356](#1356)        )),
[1357](#1357)
[1358](#1358)        _ => None,
[1359](#1359)    }
[1360](#1360)}
[1361](#1361)
[1362](#1362)pub fn alias_ident_for(expr: &Expr, default: &str) -> Ident {
[1364](#1364)    let ctxt = SyntaxContext::empty().apply_mark(Mark::fresh(Mark::root()));
[1365](#1365)    let span = expr.span();
[1366](#1366)
[1367](#1367)    let mut sym = sym_for_expr(expr).unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string());
[1368](#1368)
[1369](#1369)    if let Err(s) = Ident::verify_symbol(&sym) {
[1370](#1370)        sym = s;
[1371](#1371)    }
[1372](#1372)
[1373](#1373)    if !sym.starts_with('_') {
[1374](#1374)        sym = format!("_{sym}")
[1375](#1375)    }
[1376](#1376)    quote_ident!(ctxt, span, sym)
[1377](#1377)}

[1492](#1492)pub fn default_constructor_with_span(has_super: bool, super_call_span: Span) -> Constructor {
[1495](#1495)    trace!(has_super = has_super, "Creating a default constructor");
[1496](#1496)    let super_call_span = super_call_span.with_hi(super_call_span.lo);
[1497](#1497)
[1498](#1498)    Constructor {
[1499](#1499)        span: DUMMY_SP,
[1500](#1500)        key: PropName::Ident(atom!("constructor").into()),
[1501](#1501)        is_optional: false,
[1502](#1502)        params: if has_super {
[1503](#1503)            vec![ParamOrTsParamProp::Param(Param {
[1504](#1504)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[1505](#1505)                decorators: Vec::new(),
[1506](#1506)                pat: Pat::Rest(RestPat {
[1507](#1507)                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[1508](#1508)                    dot3_token: DUMMY_SP,
[1509](#1509)                    arg: Box::new(Pat::Ident(quote_ident!("args").into())),
[1510](#1510)                    type_ann: Default::default(),
[1511](#1511)                }),
[1512](#1512)            })]
[1513](#1513)        } else {
[1514](#1514)            Vec::new()
[1515](#1515)        },
[1516](#1516)        body: Some(BlockStmt {
[1517](#1517)            stmts: if has_super {
[1518](#1518)                vec![CallExpr {
[1519](#1519)                    span: super_call_span,
[1520](#1520)                    callee: Callee::Super(Super { span: DUMMY_SP }),
[1521](#1521)                    args: vec![ExprOrSpread {
[1522](#1522)                        spread: Some(DUMMY_SP),
[1523](#1523)                        expr: Box::new(Expr::Ident(quote_ident!("args").into())),
[1524](#1524)                    }],
[1525](#1525)                    ..Default::default()
[1526](#1526)                }
[1527](#1527)                .into_stmt()]
[1528](#1528)            } else {
[1529](#1529)                Vec::new()
[1530](#1530)            },
[1531](#1531)            ..Default::default()
[1532](#1532)        }),
[1533](#1533)        ..Default::default()
[1534](#1534)    }

[1546](#1546)pub fn opt_chain_test(
[1547](#1547)    left: Box<Expr>,
[1548](#1548)    right: Box<Expr>,
[1549](#1549)    span: Span,
[1550](#1550)    no_document_all: bool,
[1551](#1551)) -> Expr {
[1552](#1552)    if no_document_all {
[1553](#1553)        BinExpr {
[1554](#1554)            span,
[1555](#1555)            left,
[1556](#1556)            op: op!("=="),
[1557](#1557)            right: Lit::Null(Null { span: DUMMY_SP }).into(),
[1558](#1558)        }
[1559](#1559)        .into()
[1560](#1560)    } else {
[1561](#1561)        BinExpr {
[1562](#1562)            span,
[1563](#1563)            left: BinExpr {
[1564](#1564)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[1565](#1565)                left,
[1566](#1566)                op: op!("==="),
[1567](#1567)                right: Box::new(Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(Null { span: DUMMY_SP }))),
[1568](#1568)            }
[1569](#1569)            .into(),
[1570](#1570)            op: op!("||"),
[1571](#1571)            right: BinExpr {
[1572](#1572)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[1573](#1573)                left: right,
[1574](#1574)                op: op!("==="),
[1575](#1575)                right: Expr::undefined(DUMMY_SP),
[1576](#1576)            }
[1577](#1577)            .into(),
[1578](#1578)        }
[1579](#1579)        .into()
[1580](#1580)    }

[1603](#1603)pub trait IsDirective {

[1825](#1825)    pub fn consume_depth(self) -> Option<Self> {

[1827](#1827)            return None;
[1828](#1828)        }

[1830](#1830)        Some(Self {
[1831](#1831)            remaining_depth: self.remaining_depth - 1,
[1832](#1832)            ..self
[1833](#1833)        })
[1834](#1834)    }
[1835](#1835)
[1836](#1836)    pub fn preserve_effects<I>(self, span: Span, val: Box<Expr>, exprs: I) -> Box<Expr>
[1839](#1839)    where
[1840](#1840)        I: IntoIterator<Item = Box<Expr>>,
[1841](#1841)    {
[1842](#1842)        let mut exprs = exprs.into_iter().fold(Vec::new(), |mut v, e| {
[1843](#1843)            self.extract_side_effects_to(&mut v, *e);
[1844](#1844)            v
[1845](#1845)        });
[1846](#1846)
[1847](#1847)        if exprs.is_empty() {
[1848](#1848)            val
[1849](#1849)        } else {
[1850](#1850)            exprs.push(val);
[1851](#1851)
[1852](#1852)            SeqExpr { exprs, span }.into()
[1853](#1853)        }
[1854](#1854)    }
[1855](#1855)
[1856](#1856)    #[allow(clippy::vec_box)]
[1861](#1861)    pub fn extract_side_effects_to(self, to: &mut Vec<Box<Expr>>, expr: Expr) {
[1862](#1862)        match expr {
[1863](#1863)            Expr::Lit(..)
[1864](#1864)            | Expr::This(..)
[1865](#1865)            | Expr::Fn(..)
[1866](#1866)            | Expr::Arrow(..)
[1867](#1867)            | Expr::PrivateName(..) => {}
[1868](#1868)
[1869](#1869)            Expr::Ident(..) => {
[1870](#1870)                if expr.may_have_side_effects(self) {
[1871](#1871)                    to.push(Box::new(expr));
[1872](#1872)                }
[1873](#1873)            }
[1874](#1874)
[1875](#1875)            Expr::Update(_) | Expr::Assign(_) | Expr::Yield(_) | Expr::Await(_) => {
[1877](#1877)                to.push(Box::new(expr))
[1878](#1878)            }
[1879](#1879)
[1880](#1880)            Expr::MetaProp(_) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[1882](#1882)
[1883](#1883)            Expr::Call(_) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[1884](#1884)            Expr::New(e) => {
[1885](#1885)                if let Expr::Ident(Ident { ref sym, .. }) = *e.callee {
[1887](#1887)                    if *sym == "Date" && e.args.is_empty() {
[1888](#1888)                        return;
[1889](#1889)                    }
[1890](#1890)                }
[1891](#1891)
[1892](#1892)                to.push(e.into())
[1893](#1893)            }
[1894](#1894)            Expr::Member(_) | Expr::SuperProp(_) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[1895](#1895)
[1896](#1896)            Expr::Cond(_) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[1899](#1899)
[1900](#1900)            Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1901](#1901)                op: op!("typeof"),
[1902](#1902)                arg,
[1903](#1903)                ..
[1904](#1904)            }) => {
[1905](#1905)                if arg.is_ident() {
[1911](#1911)                    return;
[1912](#1912)                }
[1913](#1913)                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *arg)
[1914](#1914)            }
[1915](#1915)
[1916](#1916)            Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { arg, .. }) => self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *arg),
[1917](#1917)
[1918](#1918)            Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op, .. }) if op.may_short_circuit() => {
[1919](#1919)                to.push(Box::new(expr));
[1920](#1920)            }
[1921](#1921)            Expr::Bin(BinExpr { left, right, .. }) => {
[1922](#1922)                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *left);
[1923](#1923)                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *right);
[1924](#1924)            }
[1925](#1925)            Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { exprs, .. }) => exprs
[1926](#1926)                .into_iter()
[1927](#1927)                .for_each(|e| self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e)),
[1928](#1928)
[1929](#1929)            Expr::Paren(e) => self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e.expr),
[1930](#1930)
[1931](#1931)            Expr::Object(ObjectLit {
[1932](#1932)                span, mut props, ..
[1933](#1933)            }) => {
[1934](#1934)                let mut has_spread = false;
[1936](#1936)                props.retain(|node| match node {
[1937](#1937)                    PropOrSpread::Prop(node) => match &**node {
[1938](#1938)                        Prop::Shorthand(..) => false,
[1939](#1939)                        Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp { key, value }) => {
[1940](#1940)                            if let PropName::Computed(e) = key {
[1941](#1941)                                if e.expr.may_have_side_effects(self) {
[1942](#1942)                                    return true;
[1943](#1943)                                }
[1944](#1944)                            }
[1945](#1945)
[1946](#1946)                            value.may_have_side_effects(self)
[1947](#1947)                        }
[1948](#1948)                        Prop::Getter(GetterProp { key, .. })
[1949](#1949)                        | Prop::Setter(SetterProp { key, .. })
[1950](#1950)                        | Prop::Method(MethodProp { key, .. }) => {
[1951](#1951)                            if let PropName::Computed(e) = key {
[1952](#1952)                                e.expr.may_have_side_effects(self)
[1953](#1953)                            } else {
[1954](#1954)                                false
[1955](#1955)                            }
[1956](#1956)                        }
[1957](#1957)                        Prop::Assign(..) => {
[1958](#1958)                            unreachable!("assign property in object literal is not a valid syntax")
[1959](#1959)                        }
[1960](#1960)                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1961](#1961)                        _ => true,
[1962](#1962)                    },
[1963](#1963)                    PropOrSpread::Spread(SpreadElement { .. }) => {
[1964](#1964)                        has_spread = true;
[1965](#1965)                        true
[1966](#1966)                    }
[1967](#1967)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1968](#1968)                    _ => true,
[1969](#1969)                });
[1970](#1970)
[1971](#1971)                if has_spread {
[1972](#1972)                    to.push(ObjectLit { span, props }.into())
[1973](#1973)                } else {
[1974](#1974)                    props.into_iter().for_each(|prop| match prop {
[1975](#1975)                        PropOrSpread::Prop(node) => match *node {
[1976](#1976)                            Prop::Shorthand(..) => {}
[1977](#1977)                            Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp { key, value }) => {
[1978](#1978)                                if let PropName::Computed(e) = key {
[1979](#1979)                                    self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e.expr);
[1980](#1980)                                }
[1981](#1981)
[1982](#1982)                                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *value)
[1983](#1983)                            }
[1984](#1984)                            Prop::Getter(GetterProp { key, .. })
[1985](#1985)                            | Prop::Setter(SetterProp { key, .. })
[1986](#1986)                            | Prop::Method(MethodProp { key, .. }) => {
[1987](#1987)                                if let PropName::Computed(e) = key {
[1988](#1988)                                    self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e.expr)
[1989](#1989)                                }
[1990](#1990)                            }
[1991](#1991)                            Prop::Assign(..) => {
[1992](#1992)                                unreachable!(
[1993](#1993)                                    "assign property in object literal is not a valid syntax"
[1994](#1994)                                )
[1995](#1995)                            }
[1996](#1996)                            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1997](#1997)                            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[1998](#1998)                        },
[1999](#1999)                        _ => unreachable!(),
[2000](#2000)                    })
[2001](#2001)                }
[2002](#2002)            }
[2003](#2003)
[2004](#2004)            Expr::Array(ArrayLit { elems, .. }) => {
[2005](#2005)                elems.into_iter().flatten().fold(to, |v, e| {
[2006](#2006)                    self.extract_side_effects_to(v, *e.expr);
[2007](#2007)
[2008](#2008)                    v
[2009](#2009)                });
[2010](#2010)            }
[2011](#2011)
[2012](#2012)            Expr::TaggedTpl(TaggedTpl { tag, tpl, .. }) => {
[2013](#2013)                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *tag);
[2014](#2014)
[2015](#2015)                tpl.exprs
[2016](#2016)                    .into_iter()
[2017](#2017)                    .for_each(|e| self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e));
[2018](#2018)            }
[2019](#2019)            Expr::Tpl(Tpl { exprs, .. }) => {
[2020](#2020)                exprs
[2021](#2021)                    .into_iter()
[2022](#2022)                    .for_each(|e| self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *e));
[2023](#2023)            }
[2024](#2024)            Expr::Class(ClassExpr { .. }) => unimplemented!("add_effects for class expression"),
[2025](#2025)
[2026](#2026)            Expr::JSXMember(..)
[2027](#2027)            | Expr::JSXNamespacedName(..)
[2028](#2028)            | Expr::JSXEmpty(..)
[2029](#2029)            | Expr::JSXElement(..)
[2030](#2030)            | Expr::JSXFragment(..) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[2031](#2031)
[2032](#2032)            Expr::TsTypeAssertion(TsTypeAssertion { expr, .. })
[2033](#2033)            | Expr::TsNonNull(TsNonNullExpr { expr, .. })
[2034](#2034)            | Expr::TsAs(TsAsExpr { expr, .. })
[2035](#2035)            | Expr::TsConstAssertion(TsConstAssertion { expr, .. })
[2036](#2036)            | Expr::TsInstantiation(TsInstantiation { expr, .. })
[2037](#2037)            | Expr::TsSatisfies(TsSatisfiesExpr { expr, .. }) => {
[2038](#2038)                self.extract_side_effects_to(to, *expr)
[2039](#2039)            }
[2040](#2040)            Expr::OptChain(..) => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[2041](#2041)
[2042](#2042)            Expr::Invalid(..) => unreachable!(),
[2043](#2043)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2044](#2044)            _ => to.push(Box::new(expr)),
[2045](#2045)        }
[2046](#2046)    }

[2048](#2048)
[2049](#2049)pub fn prop_name_eq(p: &PropName, key: &str) -> bool {
[2050](#2050)    match p {
[2051](#2051)        PropName::Ident(i) => i.sym == *key,
[2052](#2052)        PropName::Str(s) => s.value == *key,
[2053](#2053)        PropName::Num(n) => n.value.to_string() == *key,
[2054](#2054)        PropName::BigInt(_) => false,
[2055](#2055)        PropName::Computed(e) => match &*e.expr {
[2056](#2056)            Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(Str { value, .. })) => *value == *key,
[2057](#2057)            _ => false,
[2058](#2058)        },
[2059](#2059)        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2060](#2060)        _ => false,
[2061](#2061)    }

[2064](#2064)pub fn replace_ident<T>(node: &mut T, from: Id, to: &Ident)
[2072](#2072)where
[2073](#2073)    T: for<'any> VisitMutWith<IdentReplacer<'any>>,

[2076](#2076)}
[2077](#2077)
[2078](#2078)pub struct IdentReplacer<'a> {
[2079](#2079)    from: Id,
[2080](#2080)    to: &'a Ident,
[2081](#2081)}
[2082](#2082)
[2083](#2083)impl VisitMut for IdentReplacer<'_> {
[2084](#2084)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[2085](#2085)
[2086](#2086)    visit_mut_obj_and_computed!();
[2087](#2087)
[2088](#2088)    fn visit_mut_prop(&mut self, node: &mut Prop) {
[2089](#2089)        match node {
[2090](#2090)            Prop::Shorthand(i) => {
[2091](#2091)                let cloned = i.clone();
[2092](#2092)                i.visit_mut_with(self);
[2093](#2093)                if i.sym != cloned.sym || i.ctxt != cloned.ctxt {
[2094](#2094)                    *node = Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[2095](#2095)                        key: PropName::Ident(IdentName::new(cloned.sym, cloned.span)),
[2096](#2096)                        value: i.clone().into(),
[2097](#2097)                    });
[2098](#2098)                }
[2099](#2099)            }
[2100](#2100)            _ => {
[2101](#2101)                node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2102](#2102)            }
[2103](#2103)        }
[2104](#2104)    }
[2105](#2105)
[2106](#2106)    fn visit_mut_ident(&mut self, node: &mut Ident) {
[2107](#2107)        if node.sym == self.from.0 && node.ctxt == self.from.1 {
[2108](#2108)            *node = self.to.clone();
[2109](#2109)        }
[2110](#2110)    }
[2111](#2111)}

[2113](#2113)pub struct BindingCollector<I>
[2114](#2114)where
[2115](#2115)    I: IdentLike + Eq + Hash + Send + Sync,
[2116](#2116){
[2117](#2117)    only: Option<SyntaxContext>,
[2118](#2118)    bindings: FxHashSet<I>,
[2119](#2119)    is_pat_decl: bool,
[2120](#2120)}
[2121](#2121)
[2122](#2122)impl<I> BindingCollector<I>
[2123](#2123)where
[2124](#2124)    I: IdentLike + Eq + Hash + Send + Sync,
[2125](#2125){
[2126](#2126)    fn add(&mut self, i: &Ident) {
[2127](#2127)        if let Some(only) = self.only {
[2128](#2128)            if only != i.ctxt {
[2129](#2129)                return;
[2130](#2130)            }
[2131](#2131)        }
[2132](#2132)

[2390](#2390)            node.orig.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2391](#2391)            return;
[2392](#2392)        }
[2393](#2393)
[2394](#2394)        match &mut node.orig {
[2395](#2395)            ModuleExportName::Ident(orig) => {
[2396](#2396)                if let Some(new) = self.map.get(&orig.to_id()) {
[2397](#2397)                    node.exported = Some(ModuleExportName::Ident(orig.clone()));
[2398](#2398)
[2399](#2399)                    orig.sym = new.0.clone();
[2400](#2400)                    orig.ctxt = new.1;
[2401](#2401)                }
[2402](#2402)            }
[2403](#2403)            ModuleExportName::Str(_) => {}
[2404](#2404)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2405](#2405)            _ => {}
[2406](#2406)        }
[2407](#2407)    }
[2408](#2408)
[2409](#2409)    fn visit_mut_ident(&mut self, node: &mut Ident) {
[2410](#2410)        if let Some(new) = self.map.get(&node.to_id()) {
[2411](#2411)            node.sym = new.0.clone();
[2412](#2412)            node.ctxt = new.1;
[2413](#2413)        }
[2414](#2414)    }
[2415](#2415)
[2416](#2416)    fn visit_mut_object_pat_prop(&mut self, i: &mut ObjectPatProp) {
[2417](#2417)        match i {
[2418](#2418)            ObjectPatProp::Assign(p) => {
[2419](#2419)                p.value.visit_mut_with(self);
[2420](#2420)
[2421](#2421)                let orig = p.key.clone();
[2422](#2422)                p.key.visit_mut_with(self);
[2423](#2423)
[2424](#2424)                if orig.ctxt == p.key.ctxt && orig.sym == p.key.sym {
[2425](#2425)                    return;
[2426](#2426)                }
[2427](#2427)
[2428](#2428)                match p.value.take() {
[2429](#2429)                    Some(default) => {
[2430](#2430)                        *i = ObjectPatProp::KeyValue(KeyValuePatProp {
[2431](#2431)                            key: PropName::Ident(orig.clone().into()),
[2432](#2432)                            value: AssignPat {
[2433](#2433)                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[2434](#2434)                                left: p.key.clone().into(),
[2435](#2435)                                right: default,
[2436](#2436)                            }
[2437](#2437)                            .into(),
[2438](#2438)                        });
[2439](#2439)                    }
[2440](#2440)                    None => {
[2441](#2441)                        *i = ObjectPatProp::KeyValue(KeyValuePatProp {
[2442](#2442)                            key: PropName::Ident(orig.clone().into()),
[2443](#2443)                            value: p.key.clone().into(),
[2444](#2444)                        });
[2445](#2445)                    }
[2446](#2446)                }
[2447](#2447)            }
[2448](#2448)
[2449](#2449)            _ => {
[2450](#2450)                i.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2451](#2451)            }
[2452](#2452)        }
[2453](#2453)    }
[2454](#2454)
[2455](#2455)    fn visit_mut_prop(&mut self, node: &mut Prop) {
[2456](#2456)        match node {

[2458](#2458)                let cloned = i.clone();
[2459](#2459)                i.visit_mut_with(self);
[2460](#2460)                if i.sym != cloned.sym || i.ctxt != cloned.ctxt {
[2461](#2461)                    *node = Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[2462](#2462)                        key: PropName::Ident(IdentName::new(cloned.sym, cloned.span)),
[2463](#2463)                        value: i.clone().into(),
[2464](#2464)                    });
[2465](#2465)                }
[2466](#2466)            }
[2467](#2467)            _ => {
[2468](#2468)                node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2469](#2469)            }
[2470](#2470)        }
[2471](#2471)    }

[2494](#2494)pub struct RefRewriter<T>

[2506](#2506)    pub fn exit_prop(&mut self, n: &mut Prop) {
[2507](#2507)        if let Prop::Shorthand(shorthand) = n {
[2508](#2508)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_ref(shorthand) {
[2509](#2509)                *n = KeyValueProp {
[2510](#2510)                    key: shorthand.take().into(),
[2511](#2511)                    value: expr,
[2512](#2512)                }
[2513](#2513)                .into()
[2514](#2514)            }
[2515](#2515)        }
[2516](#2516)    }
[2517](#2517)
[2518](#2518)    pub fn exit_pat(&mut self, n: &mut Pat) {
[2519](#2519)        if let Pat::Ident(id) = n {
[2520](#2520)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_lhs(&id.clone().into()) {
[2521](#2521)                *n = expr.into();
[2522](#2522)            }
[2523](#2523)        }
[2524](#2524)    }
[2525](#2525)
[2526](#2526)    pub fn exit_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Expr) {
[2527](#2527)        if let Expr::Ident(ref_ident) = n {
[2528](#2528)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_ref(ref_ident) {
[2529](#2529)                *n = *expr;
[2530](#2530)            }
[2531](#2531)        };
[2532](#2532)    }
[2533](#2533)
[2534](#2534)    pub fn exit_simple_assign_target(&mut self, n: &mut SimpleAssignTarget) {
[2535](#2535)        if let SimpleAssignTarget::Ident(ref_ident) = n {
[2536](#2536)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_lhs(&ref_ident.clone().into()) {
[2537](#2537)                *n = expr.try_into().unwrap();
[2538](#2538)            }
[2539](#2539)        };
[2540](#2540)    }
[2541](#2541)
[2542](#2542)    pub fn exit_jsx_element_name(&mut self, n: &mut JSXElementName) {
[2543](#2543)        if let JSXElementName::Ident(ident) = n {
[2544](#2544)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_jsx(ident) {
[2545](#2545)                *n = expr;
[2546](#2546)            }
[2547](#2547)        }
[2548](#2548)    }
[2549](#2549)
[2550](#2550)    pub fn exit_jsx_object(&mut self, n: &mut JSXObject) {
[2551](#2551)        if let JSXObject::Ident(ident) = n {
[2552](#2552)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_jsx(ident) {
[2553](#2553)                *n = match expr {
[2554](#2554)                    JSXElementName::Ident(ident) => ident.into(),
[2555](#2555)                    JSXElementName::JSXMemberExpr(expr) => Box::new(expr).into(),
[2556](#2556)                    JSXElementName::JSXNamespacedName(..) => unimplemented!(),
[2557](#2557)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2558](#2558)                    _ => return,
[2559](#2559)                }
[2560](#2560)            }
[2561](#2561)        }
[2562](#2562)    }
[2563](#2563)
[2564](#2564)    pub fn exit_object_pat_prop(&mut self, n: &mut ObjectPatProp) {
[2565](#2565)        if let ObjectPatProp::Assign(AssignPatProp { key, value, .. }) = n {
[2566](#2566)            if let Some(expr) = self.query.query_lhs(&key.id) {
[2567](#2567)                let value = value
[2568](#2568)                    .take()
[2569](#2569)                    .map(|default_value| {
[2570](#2570)                        let left = expr.clone().try_into().unwrap();
[2571](#2571)                        Box::new(default_value.make_assign_to(op!("="), left))
[2572](#2572)                    })
[2573](#2573)                    .unwrap_or(expr);
[2574](#2574)
[2575](#2575)                *n = ObjectPatProp::KeyValue(KeyValuePatProp {
[2576](#2576)                    key: PropName::Ident(key.take().into()),
[2577](#2577)                    value: value.into(),
[2578](#2578)                });
[2579](#2579)            }
[2580](#2580)        }
[2581](#2581)    }

[2626](#2626)    fn visit_mut_callee(&mut self, n: &mut Callee) {

[2637](#2637)                }

[2639](#2639)
[2640](#2640)            _ => n.visit_mut_children_with(self),
[2641](#2641)        }

[2644](#2644)    fn visit_mut_tagged_tpl(&mut self, n: &mut TaggedTpl) {

[2649](#2649)            .unwrap_or_default();
[2650](#2650)
[2651](#2651)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2652](#2652)
[2653](#2653)        if should_fix_this && n.tag.is_member() {
[2654](#2654)            *n = n.take().into_indirect()
[2655](#2655)        }
[2656](#2656)    }
[2657](#2657)
[2658](#2658)    fn visit_mut_jsx_element_name(&mut self, n: &mut JSXElementName) {
[2659](#2659)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2660](#2660)
[2661](#2661)        self.exit_jsx_element_name(n);
[2662](#2662)    }
[2663](#2663)
[2664](#2664)    fn visit_mut_jsx_object(&mut self, n: &mut JSXObject) {
[2665](#2665)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[2666](#2666)
[2667](#2667)        self.exit_jsx_object(n);
[2668](#2668)    }
[2669](#2669)}
[2670](#2670)
[2671](#2671)fn is_immutable_value(expr: &Expr) -> bool {
[2672](#2672)    match *expr {
[2681](#2681)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(..))
[2682](#2682)        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..))
[2683](#2683)        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[2684](#2684)        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => true,
[2685](#2685)
[2686](#2686)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2687](#2687)            op: op!("!"),
[2688](#2688)            ref arg,
[2689](#2689)            ..
[2690](#2690)        })
[2691](#2691)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2692](#2692)            op: op!("~"),
[2693](#2693)            ref arg,
[2694](#2694)            ..
[2695](#2695)        })
[2696](#2696)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2697](#2697)            op: op!("void"),
[2698](#2698)            ref arg,
[2699](#2699)            ..
[2700](#2700)        }) => arg.is_immutable_value(),
[2701](#2701)
[2702](#2702)        Expr::Ident(ref i) => i.sym == "undefined" || i.sym == "Infinity" || i.sym == "NaN",
[2703](#2703)
[2704](#2704)        Expr::Tpl(Tpl { ref exprs, .. }) => exprs.iter().all(|e| e.is_immutable_value()),
[2705](#2705)
[2706](#2706)        _ => false,
[2707](#2707)    }
[2708](#2708)}
[2709](#2709)
[2710](#2710)fn is_number(expr: &Expr) -> bool {
[2711](#2711)    matches!(*expr, Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..)))
[2712](#2712)}
[2713](#2713)
[2714](#2714)fn is_str(expr: &Expr) -> bool {
[2715](#2715)    match expr {
[2716](#2716)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..)) | Expr::Tpl(_) => true,
[2717](#2717)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2718](#2718)            op: op!("typeof"), ..
[2719](#2719)        }) => true,
[2720](#2720)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2721](#2721)            op: op!(bin, "+"),
[2722](#2722)            left,
[2723](#2723)            right,
[2724](#2724)            ..
[2725](#2725)        }) => left.is_str() || right.is_str(),
[2726](#2726)        Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[2727](#2727)            op: op!("=") | op!("+="),
[2728](#2728)            right,
[2729](#2729)            ..
[2730](#2730)        }) => right.is_str(),
[2731](#2731)        Expr::Seq(s) => s.exprs.last().unwrap().is_str(),
[2732](#2732)        Expr::Cond(CondExpr { cons, alt, .. }) => cons.is_str() && alt.is_str(),
[2733](#2733)        _ => false,
[2734](#2734)    }
[2735](#2735)}

[2737](#2737)fn is_array_lit(expr: &Expr) -> bool {

[2741](#2741)fn is_nan(expr: &Expr) -> bool {
