[2774](#2774)fn as_pure_bool(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> BoolValue {
[2775](#2775)    match expr.cast_to_bool(ctx) {
[2776](#2776)        (Pure, Known(b)) => Known(b),
[2777](#2777)        _ => Unknown,
[2778](#2778)    }
[2779](#2779)}
[2780](#2780)
[2781](#2781)fn cast_to_bool(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> (Purity, BoolValue) {
[2782](#2782)    let Some(ctx) = ctx.consume_depth() else {
[2783](#2783)        return (MayBeImpure, Unknown);
[2784](#2784)    };
[2785](#2785)
[2786](#2786)    if expr.is_global_ref_to(ctx, "undefined") {
[2787](#2787)        return (Pure, Known(false));
[2788](#2788)    }
[2789](#2789)    if expr.is_nan() {
[2790](#2790)        return (Pure, Known(false));
[2791](#2791)    }
[2792](#2792)
[2793](#2793)    let val = match expr {
[2794](#2794)        Expr::Paren(ref e) => return e.expr.cast_to_bool(ctx),
[2795](#2795)
[2796](#2796)        Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[2797](#2797)            ref right,
[2798](#2798)            op: op!("="),
[2799](#2799)            ..
[2800](#2800)        }) => {
[2801](#2801)            let (_, v) = right.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2802](#2802)            return (MayBeImpure, v);
[2803](#2803)        }
[2804](#2804)
[2805](#2805)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2806](#2806)            op: op!(unary, "-"),
[2807](#2807)            arg,
[2808](#2808)            ..
[2809](#2809)        }) => {
[2810](#2810)            let v = arg.as_pure_number(ctx);
[2811](#2811)            match v {
[2812](#2812)                Known(n) => Known(!matches!(n.classify(), FpCategory::Nan | FpCategory::Zero)),
[2813](#2813)                Unknown => return (MayBeImpure, Unknown),
[2814](#2814)            }
[2815](#2815)        }
[2816](#2816)
[2817](#2817)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2818](#2818)            op: op!("!"),
[2819](#2819)            ref arg,
[2820](#2820)            ..
[2821](#2821)        }) => {
[2822](#2822)            let (p, v) = arg.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2823](#2823)            return (p, !v);
[2824](#2824)        }
[2825](#2825)        Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { exprs, .. }) => exprs.last().unwrap().cast_to_bool(ctx).1,
[2826](#2826)
[2827](#2827)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2828](#2828)            left,
[2829](#2829)            op: op!(bin, "-"),
[2830](#2830)            right,
[2831](#2831)            ..
[2832](#2832)        }) => {
[2833](#2833)            let (lp, ln) = left.cast_to_number(ctx);
[2834](#2834)            let (rp, rn) = right.cast_to_number(ctx);
[2835](#2835)
[2836](#2836)            return (
[2837](#2837)                lp + rp,
[2838](#2838)                match (ln, rn) {
[2839](#2839)                    (Known(ln), Known(rn)) => {
[2840](#2840)                        if ln == rn {
[2841](#2841)                            Known(false)
[2842](#2842)                        } else {
[2843](#2843)                            Known(true)
[2844](#2844)                        }
[2845](#2845)                    }
[2846](#2846)                    _ => Unknown,
[2847](#2847)                },
[2848](#2848)            );
[2849](#2849)        }
[2850](#2850)
[2851](#2851)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2852](#2852)            left,
[2853](#2853)            op: op!("/"),
[2854](#2854)            right,
[2855](#2855)            ..
[2856](#2856)        }) => {
[2857](#2857)            let lv = left.as_pure_number(ctx);
[2858](#2858)            let rv = right.as_pure_number(ctx);
[2859](#2859)
[2860](#2860)            match (lv, rv) {
[2861](#2861)                (Known(lv), Known(rv)) => {
[2862](#2862)                    if lv == 0.0 && rv == 0.0 {
[2864](#2864)                        return (Pure, Known(false));
[2865](#2865)                    }
[2866](#2866)                    if rv == 0.0 {
[2868](#2868)                        return (Pure, Known(true));
[2869](#2869)                    }
[2870](#2870)                    let v = lv / rv;
[2871](#2871)
[2872](#2872)                    return (Pure, Known(v != 0.0));
[2873](#2873)                }
[2874](#2874)                _ => Unknown,
[2875](#2875)            }
[2876](#2876)        }
[2877](#2877)
[2878](#2878)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2879](#2879)            ref left,
[2880](#2880)            op: op @ op!("&"),
[2881](#2881)            ref right,
[2882](#2882)            ..
[2883](#2883)        })
[2884](#2884)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2885](#2885)            ref left,
[2886](#2886)            op: op @ op!("|"),
[2887](#2887)            ref right,
[2888](#2888)            ..
[2889](#2889)        }) => {
[2890](#2890)            if left.get_type(ctx) != Known(BoolType) || right.get_type(ctx) != Known(BoolType) {
[2891](#2891)                return (MayBeImpure, Unknown);
[2892](#2892)            }
[2893](#2893)
[2894](#2894)            let (lp, lv) = left.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2897](#2897)            let (rp, rv) = right.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2898](#2898)
[2899](#2899)            let v = if *op == op!("&") {
[2900](#2900)                lv.and(rv)
[2901](#2901)            } else {
[2902](#2902)                lv.or(rv)
[2903](#2903)            };
[2904](#2904)
[2905](#2905)            if lp + rp == Pure {
[2906](#2906)                return (Pure, v);
[2907](#2907)            }
[2908](#2908)
[2909](#2909)            v
[2910](#2910)        }
[2911](#2911)
[2912](#2912)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2913](#2913)            ref left,
[2914](#2914)            op: op!("||"),
[2915](#2915)            ref right,
[2916](#2916)            ..
[2917](#2917)        }) => {
[2918](#2918)            let (lp, lv) = left.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2919](#2919)            if let Known(true) = lv {
[2920](#2920)                return (lp, lv);
[2921](#2921)            }
[2922](#2922)
[2923](#2923)            let (rp, rv) = right.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2924](#2924)            if let Known(true) = rv {
[2925](#2925)                return (lp + rp, rv);
[2926](#2926)            }
[2927](#2927)
[2928](#2928)            Unknown
[2929](#2929)        }
[2930](#2930)
[2931](#2931)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2932](#2932)            ref left,
[2933](#2933)            op: op!("&&"),
[2934](#2934)            ref right,
[2935](#2935)            ..
[2936](#2936)        }) => {
[2937](#2937)            let (lp, lv) = left.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2938](#2938)            if let Known(false) = lv {
[2939](#2939)                return (lp, lv);
[2940](#2940)            }
[2941](#2941)
[2942](#2942)            let (rp, rv) = right.cast_to_bool(ctx);
[2943](#2943)            if let Known(false) = rv {
[2944](#2944)                return (lp + rp, rv);
[2945](#2945)            }
[2946](#2946)
[2947](#2947)            Unknown
[2948](#2948)        }
[2949](#2949)
[2950](#2950)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[2951](#2951)            left,
[2952](#2952)            op: op!(bin, "+"),
[2953](#2953)            right,
[2954](#2954)            ..
[2955](#2955)        }) => {
[2956](#2956)            match &**left {
[2957](#2957)                Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(s)) if !s.value.is_empty() => return (MayBeImpure, Known(true)),
[2958](#2958)                _ => {}
[2959](#2959)            }
[2960](#2960)
[2961](#2961)            match &**right {
[2962](#2962)                Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(s)) if !s.value.is_empty() => return (MayBeImpure, Known(true)),
[2963](#2963)                _ => {}
[2964](#2964)            }
[2965](#2965)
[2966](#2966)            Unknown
[2967](#2967)        }
[2968](#2968)
[2969](#2969)        Expr::Fn(..) | Expr::Class(..) | Expr::New(..) | Expr::Array(..) | Expr::Object(..) => {
[2970](#2970)            Known(true)
[2971](#2971)        }
[2972](#2972)
[2973](#2973)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[2974](#2974)            op: op!("void"), ..
[2975](#2975)        }) => Known(false),
[2976](#2976)
[2977](#2977)        Expr::Lit(ref lit) => {
[2978](#2978)            return (
[2979](#2979)                Pure,
[2980](#2980)                Known(match *lit {
[2981](#2981)                    Lit::Num(Number { value: n, .. }) => {
[2982](#2982)                        !matches!(n.classify(), FpCategory::Nan | FpCategory::Zero)
[2983](#2983)                    }
[2984](#2984)                    Lit::BigInt(ref v) => v
[2985](#2985)                        .value
[2986](#2986)                        .to_string()
[2987](#2987)                        .contains(|c: char| matches!(c, '1'..='9')),
[2988](#2988)                    Lit::Bool(b) => b.value,
[2989](#2989)                    Lit::Str(Str { ref value, .. }) => !value.is_empty(),
[2990](#2990)                    Lit::Null(..) => false,
[2991](#2991)                    Lit::Regex(..) => true,
[2992](#2992)                    Lit::JSXText(..) => unreachable!("as_bool() for JSXText"),
[2993](#2993)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2994](#2994)                    _ => return (Pure, Unknown),
[2995](#2995)                }),
[2996](#2996)            );
[2997](#2997)        }
[2998](#2998)
[2999](#2999)        _ => Unknown,
[3001](#3001)    };
[3002](#3002)
[3003](#3003)    if expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx) {
[3004](#3004)        (MayBeImpure, val)
[3005](#3005)    } else {
[3006](#3006)        (Pure, val)
[3007](#3007)    }
[3008](#3008)}
[3009](#3009)
[3010](#3010)fn cast_to_number(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> (Purity, Value<f64>) {
[3011](#3011)    let Some(ctx) = ctx.consume_depth() else {
[3012](#3012)        return (MayBeImpure, Unknown);
[3013](#3013)    };
[3014](#3014)
[3015](#3015)    let v = match expr {
[3016](#3016)        Expr::Lit(l) => match l {
[3017](#3017)            Lit::Bool(Bool { value: true, .. }) => 1.0,
[3018](#3018)            Lit::Bool(Bool { value: false, .. }) | Lit::Null(..) => 0.0,
[3019](#3019)            Lit::Num(Number { value: n, .. }) => *n,
[3020](#3020)            Lit::Str(Str { value, .. }) => {
[3021](#3021)                if let Some(value) = value.as_str() {
[3022](#3022)                    return (Pure, num_from_str(value));
[3023](#3023)                }
[3024](#3024)                return (Pure, Unknown);
[3025](#3025)            }
[3026](#3026)            _ => return (Pure, Unknown),
[3027](#3027)        },
[3028](#3028)        Expr::Array(..) => {
[3029](#3029)            let Known(s) = expr.as_pure_string(ctx) else {
[3030](#3030)                return (Pure, Unknown);
[3031](#3031)            };
[3032](#3032)
[3033](#3033)            return (Pure, num_from_str(&s));
[3034](#3034)        }
[3035](#3035)        Expr::Ident(Ident { sym, ctxt, .. }) => match &**sym {
[3036](#3036)            "undefined" | "NaN" if *ctxt == ctx.unresolved_ctxt => f64::NAN,
[3037](#3037)            "Infinity" if *ctxt == ctx.unresolved_ctxt => f64::INFINITY,
[3038](#3038)            _ => return (Pure, Unknown),
[3039](#3039)        },
[3040](#3040)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3041](#3041)            op: op!(unary, "-"),
[3042](#3042)            arg,
[3043](#3043)            ..
[3044](#3044)        }) => match arg.cast_to_number(ctx) {
[3045](#3045)            (Pure, Known(v)) => -v,
[3046](#3046)            _ => return (MayBeImpure, Unknown),
[3047](#3047)        },
[3048](#3048)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3049](#3049)            op: op!("!"),
[3050](#3050)            ref arg,
[3051](#3051)            ..
[3052](#3052)        }) => match arg.cast_to_bool(ctx) {
[3053](#3053)            (Pure, Known(v)) => {
[3054](#3054)                if v {
[3055](#3055)                    0.0
[3056](#3056)                } else {
[3057](#3057)                    1.0
[3058](#3058)                }
[3059](#3059)            }
[3060](#3060)            _ => return (MayBeImpure, Unknown),
[3061](#3061)        },
[3062](#3062)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3063](#3063)            op: op!("void"),
[3064](#3064)            ref arg,
[3065](#3065)            ..
[3066](#3066)        }) => {
[3067](#3067)            if arg.may_have_side_effects(ctx) {
[3068](#3068)                return (MayBeImpure, Known(f64::NAN));
[3069](#3069)            } else {
[3070](#3070)                f64::NAN
[3071](#3071)            }
[3072](#3072)        }
[3073](#3073)
[3074](#3074)        Expr::Tpl(..) => {
[3075](#3075)            return (
[3076](#3076)                Pure,
[3077](#3077)                num_from_str(&match expr.as_pure_string(ctx) {
[3078](#3078)                    Known(v) => v,
[3079](#3079)                    Unknown => return (MayBeImpure, Unknown),
[3080](#3080)                }),
[3081](#3081)            );
[3082](#3082)        }
[3083](#3083)
[3084](#3084)        Expr::Seq(seq) => {
[3085](#3085)            if let Some(last) = seq.exprs.last() {
[3086](#3086)                let (_, v) = last.cast_to_number(ctx);
[3087](#3087)
[3088](#3088)                return (MayBeImpure, v);
[3090](#3090)            }
[3091](#3091)
[3092](#3092)            return (MayBeImpure, Unknown);
[3093](#3093)        }
[3094](#3094)
[3095](#3095)        _ => return (MayBeImpure, Unknown),
[3096](#3096)    };
[3097](#3097)
[3098](#3098)    (Purity::Pure, Known(v))
[3099](#3099)}
[3100](#3100)
[3101](#3101)fn as_pure_number(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> Value<f64> {
[3102](#3102)    let (purity, v) = expr.cast_to_number(ctx);
[3103](#3103)    if !purity.is_pure() {
[3104](#3104)        return Unknown;
[3105](#3105)    }
[3106](#3106)
[3107](#3107)    v
[3108](#3108)}
[3109](#3109)
[3110](#3110)fn as_pure_string(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> Value<Cow<'_, str>> {
[3111](#3111)    match as_pure_wtf8(expr, ctx) {
[3112](#3112)        Known(v) => match v {
[3113](#3113)            Cow::Borrowed(v) => {
[3114](#3114)                if let Some(v) = v.as_str() {
[3115](#3115)                    Known(Cow::Borrowed(v))
[3116](#3116)                } else {
[3117](#3117)                    Unknown
[3118](#3118)                }
[3119](#3119)            }
[3120](#3120)            Cow::Owned(v) => {
[3121](#3121)                if let Ok(v) = v.into_string() {
[3122](#3122)                    Known(Cow::Owned(v))
[3123](#3123)                } else {
[3124](#3124)                    Unknown
[3125](#3125)                }
[3126](#3126)            }
[3127](#3127)        },
[3128](#3128)        Unknown => Unknown,
[3129](#3129)    }
[3130](#3130)}
[3131](#3131)
[3132](#3132)fn as_pure_wtf8(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> Value<Cow<'_, Wtf8>> {
[3133](#3133)    let Some(ctx) = ctx.consume_depth() else {
[3134](#3134)        return Unknown;
[3135](#3135)    };
[3136](#3136)
[3137](#3137)    match *expr {
[3138](#3138)        Expr::Lit(ref l) => match *l {
[3139](#3139)            Lit::Str(Str { ref value, .. }) => Known(Cow::Borrowed(&**value)),
[3140](#3140)            Lit::Num(ref n) => {
[3141](#3141)                if n.value == -0.0 {
[3142](#3142)                    return Known(Cow::Borrowed("0".into()));
[3143](#3143)                }
[3144](#3144)
[3145](#3145)                Known(Cow::Owned(Wtf8Buf::from_string(n.value.to_js_string())))
[3146](#3146)            }
[3147](#3147)            Lit::Bool(Bool { value: true, .. }) => Known(Cow::Borrowed("true".into())),
[3148](#3148)            Lit::Bool(Bool { value: false, .. }) => Known(Cow::Borrowed("false".into())),
[3149](#3149)            Lit::Null(..) => Known(Cow::Borrowed("null".into())),
[3150](#3150)            _ => Unknown,
[3151](#3151)        },
[3152](#3152)        Expr::Tpl(_) => {
[3153](#3153)            Value::Unknown
[3154](#3154)            }
[3159](#3159)        Expr::Ident(Ident { ref sym, ctxt, .. }) => match &**sym {
[3160](#3160)            "undefined" | "Infinity" | "NaN" if ctxt == ctx.unresolved_ctxt => {
[3161](#3161)                Known(Cow::Borrowed(Wtf8::from_str(sym)))
[3162](#3162)            }
[3163](#3163)            _ => Unknown,
[3164](#3164)        },
[3165](#3165)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3166](#3166)            op: op!("void"), ..
[3167](#3167)        }) => Known(Cow::Borrowed("undefined".into())),
[3168](#3168)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3169](#3169)            op: op!("!"),
[3170](#3170)            ref arg,
[3171](#3171)            ..
[3172](#3172)        }) => Known(Cow::Borrowed(match arg.as_pure_bool(ctx) {
[3173](#3173)            Known(v) => {
[3174](#3174)                if v {
[3175](#3175)                    "false".into()
[3176](#3176)                } else {
[3177](#3177)                    "true".into()
[3178](#3178)                }
[3179](#3179)            }
[3180](#3180)            Unknown => return Value::Unknown,
[3181](#3181)        })),
[3182](#3182)        Expr::Array(ArrayLit { ref elems, .. }) => {
[3183](#3183)            let mut buf = Wtf8Buf::new();
[3184](#3184)            let len = elems.len();
[3185](#3185)            for (idx, elem) in elems.iter().enumerate() {
[3187](#3187)                let last = idx == len - 1;
[3188](#3188)                let e = match *elem {
[3189](#3189)                    Some(ref elem) => {
[3190](#3190)                        let ExprOrSpread { ref expr, .. } = *elem;
[3191](#3191)                        match &**expr {
[3192](#3192)                            Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => Cow::Borrowed("".into()),
[3193](#3193)                            Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3194](#3194)                                op: op!("void"),
[3195](#3195)                                arg,
[3196](#3196)                                ..
[3197](#3197)                            }) => {
[3198](#3198)                                if arg.may_have_side_effects(ctx) {
[3199](#3199)                                    return Value::Unknown;
[3200](#3200)                                }
[3201](#3201)                                Cow::Borrowed("".into())
[3202](#3202)                            }
[3203](#3203)                            Expr::Ident(Ident { sym: undefined, .. })
[3204](#3204)                                if &**undefined == "undefined" =>
[3205](#3205)                            {
[3206](#3206)                                Cow::Borrowed("".into())
[3207](#3207)                            }
[3208](#3208)                            _ => match expr.as_pure_wtf8(ctx) {
[3209](#3209)                                Known(v) => v,
[3210](#3210)                                Unknown => return Value::Unknown,
[3211](#3211)                            },
[3212](#3212)                        }
[3213](#3213)                    }
[3214](#3214)                    None => Cow::Borrowed("".into()),
[3215](#3215)                };
[3216](#3216)                buf.push_wtf8(&e);
[3217](#3217)
[3218](#3218)                if !last {
[3219](#3219)                    buf.push_char(',');
[3220](#3220)                }
[3221](#3221)            }
[3222](#3222)            Known(buf.into())
[3223](#3223)        }
[3224](#3224)        _ => Unknown,
[3225](#3225)    }
[3226](#3226)}
[3227](#3227)
[3228](#3228)fn get_type(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> Value<Type> {
[3229](#3229)    let Some(ctx) = ctx.consume_depth() else {
[3230](#3230)        return Unknown;
[3231](#3231)    };
[3232](#3232)
[3233](#3233)    match expr {
[3234](#3234)        Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[3235](#3235)            ref right,
[3236](#3236)            op: op!("="),
[3237](#3237)            ..
[3238](#3238)        }) => right.get_type(ctx),
[3239](#3239)
[3240](#3240)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[3241](#3241)            obj,
[3242](#3242)            prop: MemberProp::Ident(IdentName { sym: length, .. }),
[3243](#3243)            ..
[3244](#3244)        }) if &**length == "length" => match &**obj {
[3245](#3245)            Expr::Array(ArrayLit { .. }) | Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..)) => Known(Type::Num),
[3246](#3246)            Expr::Ident(Ident { sym: arguments, .. }) if &**arguments == "arguments" => {
[3247](#3247)                Known(Type::Num)
[3248](#3248)            }
[3249](#3249)            _ => Unknown,
[3250](#3250)        },
[3251](#3251)
[3252](#3252)        Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { ref exprs, .. }) => exprs
[3253](#3253)            .last()
[3254](#3254)            .expect("sequence expression should not be empty")
[3255](#3255)            .get_type(ctx),
[3256](#3256)
[3257](#3257)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[3258](#3258)            ref left,
[3259](#3259)            op: op!("&&"),
[3260](#3260)            ref right,
[3261](#3261)            ..
[3262](#3262)        })
[3263](#3263)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[3264](#3264)            ref left,
[3265](#3265)            op: op!("||"),
[3266](#3266)            ref right,
[3267](#3267)            ..
[3268](#3268)        })
[3269](#3269)        | Expr::Cond(CondExpr {
[3270](#3270)            cons: ref left,
[3271](#3271)            alt: ref right,
[3272](#3272)            ..
[3273](#3273)        }) => and(left.get_type(ctx), right.get_type(ctx)),
[3274](#3274)
[3275](#3275)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[3276](#3276)            ref left,
[3277](#3277)            op: op!(bin, "+"),
[3278](#3278)            ref right,
[3279](#3279)            ..
[3280](#3280)        }) => {
[3281](#3281)            let rt = right.get_type(ctx);
[3282](#3282)            if rt == Known(StringType) {
[3283](#3283)                return Known(StringType);
[3284](#3284)            }
[3285](#3285)
[3286](#3286)            let lt = left.get_type(ctx);
[3287](#3287)            if lt == Known(StringType) {
[3288](#3288)                return Known(StringType);
[3289](#3289)            }
[3290](#3290)
[3291](#3291)            if lt == Known(ObjectType) || rt == Known(ObjectType) {
[3295](#3295)                return Unknown;
[3296](#3296)            }
[3297](#3297)
[3298](#3298)            if !may_be_str(lt) && !may_be_str(rt) {
[3299](#3299)                return Known(NumberType);
[3302](#3302)            }
[3303](#3303)
[3304](#3304)            Unknown
[3308](#3308)        }
[3309](#3309)
[3310](#3310)        Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[3311](#3311)            op: op!("+="),
[3312](#3312)            ref right,
[3313](#3313)            ..
[3314](#3314)        }) => {
[3315](#3315)            if right.get_type(ctx) == Known(StringType) {
[3316](#3316)                return Known(StringType);
[3317](#3317)            }
[3318](#3318)            Unknown
[3319](#3319)        }
[3320](#3320)
[3321](#3321)        Expr::Ident(Ident { ref sym, .. }) => Known(match &**sym {
[3322](#3322)            "undefined" => UndefinedType,
[3323](#3323)            "NaN" | "Infinity" => NumberType,
[3324](#3324)            _ => return Unknown,
[3325](#3325)        }),
[3326](#3326)
[3327](#3327)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(..))
[3328](#3328)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("&="), .. })
[3329](#3329)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("^="), .. })
[3330](#3330)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("|="), .. })
[3331](#3331)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("<<="), .. })
[3332](#3332)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!(">>="), .. })
[3333](#3333)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[3334](#3334)            op: op!(">>>="), ..
[3335](#3335)        })
[3336](#3336)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("-="), .. })
[3337](#3337)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("*="), .. })
[3338](#3338)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("**="), .. })
[3339](#3339)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("/="), .. })
[3340](#3340)        | Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { op: op!("%="), .. })
[3341](#3341)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { op: op!("~"), .. })
[3342](#3342)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("|"), .. })
[3343](#3343)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("^"), .. })
[3344](#3344)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("&"), .. })
[3345](#3345)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("<<"), .. })
[3346](#3346)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!(">>"), .. })
[3347](#3347)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!(">>>"), .. })
[3348](#3348)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[3349](#3349)            op: op!(bin, "-"), ..
[3350](#3350)        })
[3351](#3351)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("*"), .. })
[3352](#3352)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("%"), .. })
[3353](#3353)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("/"), .. })
[3354](#3354)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("**"), .. })
[3355](#3355)        | Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { op: op!("++"), .. })
[3356](#3356)        | Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { op: op!("--"), .. })
[3357](#3357)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3358](#3358)            op: op!(unary, "+"),
[3359](#3359)            ..
[3360](#3360)        })
[3361](#3361)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3362](#3362)            op: op!(unary, "-"),
[3363](#3363)            ..
[3364](#3364)        }) => Known(NumberType),
[3365](#3365)
[3366](#3366)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(..))
[3368](#3368)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("=="), .. })
[3369](#3369)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("!="), .. })
[3370](#3370)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("==="), .. })
[3371](#3371)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("!=="), .. })
[3372](#3372)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("<"), .. })
[3373](#3373)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("<="), .. })
[3374](#3374)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!(">"), .. })
[3375](#3375)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!(">="), .. })
[3376](#3376)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr { op: op!("in"), .. })
[3377](#3377)        | Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[3378](#3378)            op: op!("instanceof"),
[3379](#3379)            ..
[3380](#3380)        })
[3381](#3381)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { op: op!("!"), .. })
[3382](#3382)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3383](#3383)            op: op!("delete"), ..
[3384](#3384)        }) => Known(BoolType),
[3385](#3385)
[3386](#3386)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3387](#3387)            op: op!("typeof"), ..
[3388](#3388)        })
[3389](#3389)        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Str { .. })
[3390](#3390)        | Expr::Tpl(..) => Known(StringType),
[3391](#3391)
[3392](#3392)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => Known(NullType),
[3393](#3393)
[3394](#3394)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3395](#3395)            op: op!("void"), ..
[3396](#3396)        }) => Known(UndefinedType),
[3397](#3397)
[3398](#3398)        Expr::Fn(..)
[3399](#3399)        | Expr::New(NewExpr { .. })
[3400](#3400)        | Expr::Array(ArrayLit { .. })
[3401](#3401)        | Expr::Object(ObjectLit { .. })
[3402](#3402)        | Expr::Lit(Lit::Regex(..)) => Known(ObjectType),
[3403](#3403)
[3404](#3404)        _ => Unknown,
[3405](#3405)    }
[3406](#3406)}
[3407](#3407)
[3408](#3408)fn is_pure_callee(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> bool {
[3409](#3409)    if expr.is_global_ref_to(ctx, "Date") {
[3410](#3410)        return true;
[3411](#3411)    }
[3412](#3412)
[3413](#3413)    match expr {
[3414](#3414)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[3415](#3415)            obj,
[3416](#3416)            prop: MemberProp::Ident(prop),
[3417](#3417)            ..
[3418](#3418)        }) => {
[3419](#3419)            fn is_pure_str_method(method: &str) -> bool {
[3421](#3421)                matches!(
[3422](#3422)                    method,
[3423](#3423)                    "charAt"
[3424](#3424)                        | "charCodeAt"
[3425](#3425)                        | "concat"
[3426](#3426)                        | "endsWith"
[3427](#3427)                        | "includes"
[3428](#3428)                        | "indexOf"
[3429](#3429)                        | "lastIndexOf"
[3430](#3430)                        | "localeCompare"
[3431](#3431)                        | "slice"
[3432](#3432)                        | "split"
[3433](#3433)                        | "startsWith"
[3434](#3434)                        | "substr"
[3435](#3435)                        | "substring"
[3436](#3436)                        | "toLocaleLowerCase"
[3437](#3437)                        | "toLocaleUpperCase"
[3438](#3438)                        | "toLowerCase"
[3439](#3439)                        | "toString"
[3440](#3440)                        | "toUpperCase"
[3441](#3441)                        | "trim"
[3442](#3442)                        | "trimEnd"
[3443](#3443)                        | "trimStart"
[3444](#3444)                )
[3445](#3445)            }
[3446](#3446)
[3447](#3447)            obj.is_global_ref_to(ctx, "Math")
[3448](#3448)                || match &**obj {
[3449](#3449)                    Expr::Ident(Ident {
[3451](#3451)                        ctxt, sym: math, ..
[3452](#3452)                    }) => &**math == "Math" && *ctxt == SyntaxContext::empty(),
[3453](#3453)
[3454](#3454)                    Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..)) => is_pure_str_method(&prop.sym),
[3455](#3455)                    Expr::Tpl(Tpl { exprs, .. }) if exprs.is_empty() => {
[3456](#3456)                        is_pure_str_method(&prop.sym)
[3457](#3457)                    }
[3458](#3458)
[3459](#3459)                    _ => false,
[3460](#3460)                }
[3461](#3461)        }
[3462](#3462)
[3463](#3463)        Expr::Fn(FnExpr { function: f, .. })
[3464](#3464)            if f.params.iter().all(|p| p.pat.is_ident())
[3465](#3465)                && f.body.is_some()
[3466](#3466)                && f.body.as_ref().unwrap().stmts.is_empty() =>
[3467](#3467)        {
[3468](#3468)            true
[3469](#3469)        }
[3470](#3470)
[3471](#3471)        _ => false,
[3472](#3472)    }
[3473](#3473)}
[3474](#3474)
[3475](#3475)fn may_have_side_effects(expr: &Expr, ctx: ExprCtx) -> bool {
[3476](#3476)    let Some(ctx) = ctx.consume_depth() else {
[3477](#3477)        return true;
[3478](#3478)    };
[3479](#3479)
[3480](#3480)    if expr.is_pure_callee(ctx) {
[3481](#3481)        return false;
[3482](#3482)    }
[3483](#3483)
[3484](#3484)    match expr {
[3485](#3485)        Expr::Ident(i) => {
[3486](#3486)            if ctx.is_unresolved_ref_safe {
[3487](#3487)                return false;
[3488](#3488)            }
[3489](#3489)
[3490](#3490)            if i.ctxt == ctx.unresolved_ctxt {
[3491](#3491)                !matches!(
[3492](#3492)                    &*i.sym,
[3493](#3493)                    "Infinity"
[3494](#3494)                        | "NaN"
[3495](#3495)                        | "Math"
[3496](#3496)                        | "undefined"
[3497](#3497)                        | "Object"
[3498](#3498)                        | "Array"
[3499](#3499)                        | "Promise"
[3500](#3500)                        | "Boolean"
[3501](#3501)                        | "Number"
[3502](#3502)                        | "String"
[3503](#3503)                        | "BigInt"
[3504](#3504)                        | "Error"
[3505](#3505)                        | "RegExp"
[3506](#3506)                        | "Function"
[3507](#3507)                        | "document"
[3508](#3508)                )
[3509](#3509)            } else {
[3510](#3510)                false
[3511](#3511)            }
[3512](#3512)        }
[3513](#3513)
[3514](#3514)        Expr::Lit(..) | Expr::This(..) | Expr::PrivateName(..) | Expr::TsConstAssertion(..) => {
[3515](#3515)            false
[3516](#3516)        }
[3517](#3517)
[3518](#3518)        Expr::Paren(e) => e.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3519](#3519)
[3520](#3520)        Expr::Fn(..) | Expr::Arrow(..) => false,
[3522](#3522)
[3523](#3523)        Expr::Class(c) => class_has_side_effect(ctx, &c.class),
[3525](#3525)        Expr::Array(ArrayLit { elems, .. }) => elems
[3526](#3526)            .iter()
[3527](#3527)            .filter_map(|e| e.as_ref())
[3528](#3528)            .any(|e| e.spread.is_some() || e.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx)),
[3529](#3529)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[3530](#3530)            op: op!("delete"), ..
[3531](#3531)        }) => true,
[3532](#3532)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { arg, .. }) => arg.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3533](#3533)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr { left, right, .. }) => {
[3534](#3534)            left.may_have_side_effects(ctx) || right.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[3535](#3535)        }
[3536](#3536)
[3537](#3537)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr { obj, prop, .. })
[3538](#3538)            if obj.is_object() || obj.is_fn_expr() || obj.is_arrow() || obj.is_class() =>
[3539](#3539)        {
[3540](#3540)            if obj.may_have_side_effects(ctx) {
[3541](#3541)                return true;
[3542](#3542)            }
[3543](#3543)            match &**obj {
[3544](#3544)                Expr::Class(c) => {
[3545](#3545)                    let is_static_accessor = |member: &ClassMember| {
[3546](#3546)                        if let ClassMember::Method(ClassMethod {
[3547](#3547)                            kind: MethodKind::Getter | MethodKind::Setter,
[3548](#3548)                            is_static: true,
[3549](#3549)                            ..
[3550](#3550)                        }) = member
[3551](#3551)                        {
[3552](#3552)                            true
[3553](#3553)                        } else {
[3554](#3554)                            false
[3555](#3555)                        }
[3556](#3556)                    };
[3557](#3557)                    if c.class.body.iter().any(is_static_accessor) {
[3558](#3558)                        return true;
[3559](#3559)                    }
[3560](#3560)                }
[3561](#3561)                Expr::Object(obj) => {
[3562](#3562)                    let can_have_side_effect = |prop: &PropOrSpread| match prop {
[3563](#3563)                        PropOrSpread::Spread(_) => true,
[3564](#3564)                        PropOrSpread::Prop(prop) => match prop.as_ref() {
[3565](#3565)                            Prop::Getter(_) | Prop::Setter(_) | Prop::Method(_) => true,
[3566](#3566)                            Prop::Shorthand(Ident { sym, .. })
[3567](#3567)                            | Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[3568](#3568)                                key: PropName::Ident(IdentName { sym, .. }),
[3569](#3569)                                ..
[3570](#3570)                            }) => &**sym == "__proto__",
[3571](#3571)                            Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[3572](#3572)                                key: PropName::Str(Str { value: sym, .. }),
[3573](#3573)                                ..
[3574](#3574)                            }) => &**sym == "__proto__",
[3575](#3575)                            Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp {
[3576](#3576)                                key: PropName::Computed(_),
[3577](#3577)                                ..
[3578](#3578)                            }) => true,
[3579](#3579)                            _ => false,
[3580](#3580)                        },
[3581](#3581)                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[3582](#3582)                        _ => true,
[3583](#3583)                    };
[3584](#3584)                    if obj.props.iter().any(can_have_side_effect) {
[3585](#3585)                        return true;
[3586](#3586)                    }
[3587](#3587)                }
[3588](#3588)                _ => {}
[3589](#3589)            };
[3590](#3590)
[3591](#3591)            match prop {
[3592](#3592)                MemberProp::Computed(c) => c.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3593](#3593)                MemberProp::Ident(_) | MemberProp::PrivateName(_) => false,
[3594](#3594)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[3595](#3595)                _ => true,
[3596](#3596)            }
[3597](#3597)        }
[3598](#3598)
[3599](#3599)        Expr::Tpl(_) => true,
[3601](#3601)        Expr::TaggedTpl(_) => true,
[3602](#3602)        Expr::MetaProp(_) => true,
[3603](#3603)
[3604](#3604)        Expr::Await(_)
[3605](#3605)        | Expr::Yield(_)
[3606](#3606)        | Expr::Member(_)
[3607](#3607)        | Expr::SuperProp(_)
[3608](#3608)        | Expr::Update(_)
[3609](#3609)        | Expr::Assign(_) => true,
[3610](#3610)
[3611](#3611)        Expr::OptChain(OptChainExpr { base, .. }) if matches!(&**base, OptChainBase::Member(_)) => {
[3612](#3612)            true
[3613](#3613)        }
[3614](#3614)
[3615](#3615)        Expr::New(_) => true,
[3617](#3617)
[3618](#3618)        Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[3619](#3619)            callee: Callee::Expr(callee),
[3620](#3620)            ref args,
[3621](#3621)            ..
[3622](#3622)        }) if callee.is_pure_callee(ctx) => {
[3623](#3623)            args.iter().any(|arg| arg.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[3624](#3624)        }
[3625](#3625)        Expr::OptChain(OptChainExpr { base, .. })
[3626](#3626)            if matches!(&**base, OptChainBase::Call(..))
[3627](#3627)                && OptChainBase::as_call(base)
[3628](#3628)                    .unwrap()
[3629](#3629)                    .callee
[3630](#3630)                    .is_pure_callee(ctx) =>
[3631](#3631)        {
[3632](#3632)            OptChainBase::as_call(base)
[3633](#3633)                .unwrap()
[3634](#3634)                .args
[3635](#3635)                .iter()
[3636](#3636)                .any(|arg| arg.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx))
[3637](#3637)        }
[3638](#3638)
[3639](#3639)        Expr::Call(_) | Expr::OptChain(..) => true,
[3640](#3640)
[3641](#3641)        Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { exprs, .. }) => exprs.iter().any(|e| e.may_have_side_effects(ctx)),
[3642](#3642)
[3643](#3643)        Expr::Cond(CondExpr {
[3644](#3644)            test, cons, alt, ..
[3645](#3645)        }) => {
[3646](#3646)            test.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[3647](#3647)                || cons.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[3648](#3648)                || alt.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[3649](#3649)        }
[3650](#3650)
[3651](#3651)        Expr::Object(ObjectLit { props, .. }) => props.iter().any(|node| match node {
[3652](#3652)            PropOrSpread::Prop(node) => match &**node {
[3653](#3653)                Prop::Shorthand(..) => false,
[3654](#3654)                Prop::KeyValue(KeyValueProp { key, value }) => {
[3655](#3655)                    let k = match key {
[3656](#3656)                        PropName::Computed(e) => e.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3657](#3657)                        _ => false,
[3658](#3658)                    };
[3659](#3659)
[3660](#3660)                    k || value.may_have_side_effects(ctx)
[3661](#3661)                }
[3662](#3662)                Prop::Getter(GetterProp { key, .. })
[3663](#3663)                | Prop::Setter(SetterProp { key, .. })
[3664](#3664)                | Prop::Method(MethodProp { key, .. }) => match key {
[3665](#3665)                    PropName::Computed(e) => e.expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3666](#3666)                    _ => false,
[3667](#3667)                },
[3668](#3668)                Prop::Assign(_) => true,
[3669](#3669)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[3670](#3670)                _ => true,
[3671](#3671)            },
[3672](#3672)            PropOrSpread::Spread(_) => true,
[3674](#3674)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[3675](#3675)            _ => true,
[3676](#3676)        }),
[3677](#3677)
[3678](#3678)        Expr::JSXMember(..)
[3679](#3679)        | Expr::JSXNamespacedName(..)
[3680](#3680)        | Expr::JSXEmpty(..)
[3681](#3681)        | Expr::JSXElement(..)
[3682](#3682)        | Expr::JSXFragment(..) => true,
[3683](#3683)
[3684](#3684)        Expr::TsAs(TsAsExpr { ref expr, .. })
[3685](#3685)        | Expr::TsNonNull(TsNonNullExpr { ref expr, .. })
[3686](#3686)        | Expr::TsTypeAssertion(TsTypeAssertion { ref expr, .. })
[3687](#3687)        | Expr::TsInstantiation(TsInstantiation { ref expr, .. })
[3688](#3688)        | Expr::TsSatisfies(TsSatisfiesExpr { ref expr, .. }) => expr.may_have_side_effects(ctx),
[3689](#3689)
[3690](#3690)        Expr::Invalid(..) => true,
[3691](#3691)        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[3692](#3692)        _ => true,
[3693](#3693)    }
[3694](#3694)}

# swc_ecma_utils::str - Rust

# Module str

[Source](../../src/swc_ecma_utils/str.rs.html#1-103) - [CR](constant.CR.html)
- U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN, abbreviated in the spec as `<CR>`.
- [EOF](constant.EOF.html)
- [FF](constant.FF.html)
- U+000C FORM FEED, abbreviated `<FF>`.
- [LF](constant.LF.html)
- U+000A LINE FEED, abbreviated in the spec as `<LF>`.
- [LS](constant.LS.html)
- U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR, abbreviated `<LS>`.
- [NBSP](constant.NBSP.html)
- U+00A0 NON-BREAKING SPACE, abbreviated `<NBSP>`.
- [PS](constant.PS.html)
- U+2029 PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR, abbreviated `<PS>`.
- [SP](constant.SP.html)
- U+0020 SPACE, abbreviated `<SP>`.
- [TAB](constant.TAB.html)
- U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION, abbreviated `<TAB>`.
- [VT](constant.VT.html)
- U+000B VERTICAL TAB, abbreviated `<VT>`.
- [ZWJ](constant.ZWJ.html)
- U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER, abbreviated as `<ZWJ>`.
Specially permitted in identifiers.
- [ZWNBSP](constant.ZWNBSP.html)
- U+FEFF ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE, abbreviated `<ZWNBSP>`.
Considered a whitespace character in JS.
- [ZWNJ](constant.ZWNJ.html)
- U+200C ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER, abbreviated in the spec as `<ZWNJ>`.
Specially permitted in identifiers.

- [is_irregular_line_terminator](fn.is_irregular_line_terminator.html)
- [is_irregular_whitespace](fn.is_irregular_whitespace.html)
- [is_line_terminator](fn.is_line_terminator.html)
- [is_regular_line_terminator](fn.is_regular_line_terminator.html)
- [is_white_space_single_line](fn.is_white_space_single_line.html)

# swc_ecma_utils::unicode - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/unicode/index.html

## Functions[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#functions)

- [code_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.code_point_to_pair.html)- point_ - to_ - pair
- Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair. Returns (high_surrogate, low_surrogate) both as u32.
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_high_surrogate.html)- high_ - surrogate
- Returns true if `u`is a high surrogate (in the range 0xD800..=0xDBFF).
- [is_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.is_low_surrogate.html)- low_ - surrogate
- Returns true if `u`is a low surrogate (in the range 0xDC00..=0xDFFF).
- [pair_](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/fn.pair_to_code_point.html)- to_ - code_ - point
- Converts UTF-16 surrogate pair to Unicode code point.
`https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-utf16decodesurrogatepair`

# member_expr in swc_ecma_utils - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/macro.member_expr.html

```
macro_rules! member_expr {
    ($ctxt:expr, $span:expr, $first:ident) => { ... };
    ($ctxt:expr, $span:expr, $first:ident . $($rest:tt)+) => { ... };
    (@EXT, $span:expr, $obj:expr, $first:ident . $($rest:tt)* ) => { ... };
    (@EXT, $span:expr, $obj:expr,  $first:ident) => { ... };
}
```

# private_ident in swc_ecma_utils - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/macro.private_ident.html

```
macro_rules! private_ident {
    ($s:literal) => { ... };
    ($s:expr) => { ... };
    ($span:expr, $s:expr) => { ... };
}
```
## Expand description

Shortcut for `quote_ident!(span.apply_mark(Mark::fresh(Mark::root())), s)`

```
macro_rules! private_ident {
    ($s:literal) => { ... };
    ($s:expr) => { ... };
    ($span:expr, $s:expr) => { ... };
}
```
Shortcut for `quote_ident!(span.apply_mark(Mark::fresh(Mark::root())), s)`

macro_rules! quote_expr {

}

# quote_ident in swc_ecma_utils - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/macro.quote_ident.html

```
macro_rules! quote_ident {
    ($s:literal) => { ... };
    ($s:expr) => { ... };
    ($ctxt:expr, $s:literal) => { ... };
    ($ctxt:expr, $s:expr) => { ... };
    ($ctxt:expr, $span:expr, $s:expr) => { ... };
}
```
## Expand description

As we have multiple identifier types, the expected usage is
`quote_ident!("foo").into()`.

---

# ExprCtx in swc_ecma_utils - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/struct.ExprCtx.html

```
pub struct ExprCtx {
    pub unresolved_ctxt: SyntaxContext,
    pub is_unresolved_ref_safe:
```
[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html),
    pub in_strict: [bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html),
    pub remaining_depth: [u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html),
}## Fields[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#fields)

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.unresolved_ctxt)

`unresolved_ctxt: SyntaxContext`This [SyntaxContext] should be applied only to unresolved references.

In other words, this should be applied to identifier references to
global objects like `Object` or `Math`, and when those are not shadowed
by a local declaration.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.is_unresolved_ref_safe)

`is_unresolved_ref_safe: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)True for argument of `typeof`.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.in_strict)

`in_strict: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)True if we are in the strict mode. This will be set to `true` for
statements **after** `'use strict'`

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.remaining_depth)

`remaining_depth: `[u8](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.u8.html)Remaining depth of the current expression. If this is 0, it means the function should not operate and return the safe value.

Default value is `4`

[as_class_decl](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#method.as_class_decl)(self) -> [Option](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/option/enum.Option.html)<ClassDecl> { ... }

       where T: [Into](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/convert/trait.Into.html)<Expr> { ... }
[make_bin](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#method.make_bin)<T>(self, op: BinaryOp, right: T) -> Expr
       where T: [Into](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/convert/trait.Into.html)<Expr> { ... }
[make_assign_to](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#method.make_assign_to)(self, op: AssignOp, left: AssignTarget) -> Expr { ... }
[make_member](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#method.make_member)(self, prop: IdentName) -> MemberExpr { ... }
[computed_member](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#method.computed_member)<T>(self, prop: T) -> MemberExpr
       where T: [Into](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/convert/trait.Into.html)<[Box](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/alloc/boxed/struct.Box.html)<Expr>> { ... }
}## Expand description

Extension methods for [Expr].

Note that many types implements `Into<Expr>` and you can do like

```
use swc_ecma_utils::ExprFactory;
let _args = vec![0f64.as_arg()];
```
to create literals. Almost all rust core types implements `Into<Expr>`.

## Provided Methods[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#provided-methods)

Creates an [ExprOrSpread] using the given [Expr].

This is recommended way to create [ExprOrSpread].

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#example)Example

```
use swc_common::DUMMY_SP;
use swc_ecma_ast::*;
use swc_ecma_utils::ExprFactory;
let first = Lit::Num(Number {
    span: DUMMY_SP,
    value: 0.0,
    raw: None,
});
let _args = vec![first.as_arg()];
```
[Source](https://rustdoc.swc.rs/src/swc_ecma_utils/factory.rs.html#67-69)

This trait is **not** [dyn compatible](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/reference/items/traits.html#dyn-compatibility).

*In older versions of Rust, dyn compatibility was called "object safety", so this trait is not object safe.*

This does not recurse into a function if `this` is changed by it.

e.g.

- The body of an arrow expression is visited.
- The body of a function expression is **not**visited.

[Source](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/src/core/num/f64.rs.html#497)

[Source](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/src/core/num/f64.rs.html#500)

#### pub const [NEG_INFINITY](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#associatedconstant.NEG_INFINITY): [f64](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.f64.html) = -Inf_f64

Returns the ordering between `self` and `other`.

Unlike the standard partial comparison between floating point numbers,
this comparison always produces an ordering in accordance to
the `totalOrder` predicate as defined in the IEEE 754 (2008 revision)
floating point standard. The values are ordered in the following sequence:

- negative quiet NaN
- negative signaling NaN
- negative infinity
- negative numbers
- negative subnormal numbers
- negative zero
- positive zero
- positive subnormal numbers
- positive numbers
- positive infinity
- positive signaling NaN
- positive quiet NaN.

The ordering established by this function does not always agree with the
[ PartialOrd](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/trait.PartialOrd.html) and

[implementations of](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/core/cmp/trait.PartialEq.html)

`PartialEq``f64`. For example,
they consider negative and positive zero equal, while `total_cmp`
doesn’t.The interpretation of the signaling NaN bit follows the definition in the IEEE 754 standard, which may not match the interpretation by some of the older, non-conformant (e.g. MIPS) hardware implementations.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#example)Example

```
struct GoodBoy {
    name: String,
    weight: f64,
}
let mut bois = vec![
    GoodBoy { name: "Pucci".to_owned(), weight: 0.1 },
    GoodBoy { name: "Woofer".to_owned(), weight: 99.0 },
    GoodBoy { name: "Yapper".to_owned(), weight: 10.0 },
    GoodBoy { name: "Chonk".to_owned(), weight: f64::INFINITY },
    GoodBoy { name: "Abs. Unit".to_owned(), weight: f64::NAN },
    GoodBoy { name: "Floaty".to_owned(), weight: -5.0 },
];
bois.sort_by(|a, b| a.weight.total_cmp(&b.weight));
// `f64::NAN` could be positive or negative, which will affect the sort order.
if f64::NAN.is_sign_negative() {
    assert!(bois.into_iter().map(|b| b.weight)
        .zip([f64::NAN, -5.0, 0.1, 10.0, 99.0, f64::INFINITY].iter())
        .all(|(a, b)| a.to_bits() == b.to_bits()))
} else {
    assert!(bois.into_iter().map(|b| b.weight)
        .zip([-5.0, 0.1, 10.0, 99.0, f64::INFINITY, f64::NAN].iter())
        .all(|(a, b)| a.to_bits() == b.to_bits()))
}
```

# code_point_to_pair in swc_ecma_utils::unicode - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/unicode/fn.code_point_to_pair.html

## Expand description

Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 surrogate pair. Returns (high_surrogate, low_surrogate) both as u32.

For code point < 0x10000, which is not represented by a surrogate pair,
returns `None`

---

# is_high_surrogate in swc_ecma_utils::unicode - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/unicode/fn.is_high_surrogate.html

## Expand description

Returns true if `u` is a high surrogate (in the range 0xD800..=0xDBFF).

---

# is_low_surrogate in swc_ecma_utils::unicode - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/unicode/fn.is_low_surrogate.html

## Expand description

Returns true if `u` is a low surrogate (in the range 0xDC00..=0xDFFF).

---

# pair_to_code_point in swc_ecma_utils::unicode - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_utils/unicode/fn.pair_to_code_point.html

## Expand description

Converts UTF-16 surrogate pair to Unicode code point.
`https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-utf16decodesurrogatepair`

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#panics)Panics

Panics if `high` is not in the range 0xD800..=0xDBFF or `low` is not in the
range 0xDC00..=0xDFFF.

---

[117](#117)    fn merge(&mut self, rhs: Self) {
[118](#118)        *self = match (*self, rhs) {
[119](#119)            (None, None) => None,
[120](#120)            (None, Some(ty)) | (Some(ty), None) => Some(ty),
[121](#121)            (Some(ty1), Some(ty2)) if ty1 == ty2 => Some(ty1),
[122](#122)            _ => Some(Unknown),
[123](#123)        }
[124](#124)    }

[7](#7)use crate::ExprFactory;
[8](#8)
[9](#9)pub fn inject_after_super(c: &mut Constructor, exprs: Vec<Box<Expr>>) {
[10](#10)    if exprs.is_empty() {
[11](#11)        return;
[12](#12)    }
[13](#13)
[14](#14)    let body = c.body.as_mut().expect("constructor should have a body");
[15](#15)
[16](#16)    let mut injector = Injector {
[17](#17)        exprs,
[18](#18)        ..Default::default()
[19](#19)    };
[20](#20)
[21](#21)    body.visit_mut_with(&mut injector);
[22](#22)
[23](#23)    if !injector.injected {
[24](#24)        let exprs = injector.exprs.take();
[25](#25)        body.stmts
[26](#26)            .splice(0..0, exprs.into_iter().map(|e| e.into_stmt()));
[27](#27)    }
[28](#28)}
[29](#29)
[30](#30)#[derive(Default)]
[31](#31)struct Injector {
[32](#32)    exprs: Vec<Box<Expr>>,
[33](#33)    ignore_return_value: bool,
[34](#34)
[35](#35)    injected: bool,
[36](#36)}
[37](#37)
[38](#38)impl VisitMut for Injector {
[39](#39)    noop_visit_mut_type!();
[40](#40)
[41](#41)    fn visit_mut_constructor(&mut self, _: &mut Constructor) {
[42](#42)        }
[44](#44)
[45](#45)    fn visit_mut_function(&mut self, _: &mut Function) {
[46](#46)        }
[48](#48)
[49](#49)    fn visit_mut_getter_prop(&mut self, _: &mut GetterProp) {
[50](#50)        }
[52](#52)
[53](#53)    fn visit_mut_setter_prop(&mut self, _: &mut SetterProp) {
[54](#54)        }
[56](#56)
[57](#57)    fn visit_mut_expr_stmt(&mut self, node: &mut ExprStmt) {
[58](#58)        let ignore_return_value = mem::replace(&mut self.ignore_return_value, true);
[59](#59)        node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[60](#60)        self.ignore_return_value = ignore_return_value;
[61](#61)    }
[62](#62)
[63](#63)    fn visit_mut_seq_expr(&mut self, node: &mut SeqExpr) {
[64](#64)        if let Some(mut tail) = node.exprs.pop() {
[65](#65)            let ignore_return_value = mem::replace(&mut self.ignore_return_value, true);
[66](#66)            node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[67](#67)            self.ignore_return_value = ignore_return_value;
[68](#68)            tail.visit_mut_with(self);
[69](#69)            node.exprs.push(tail);
[70](#70)        }
[71](#71)    }
[72](#72)
[73](#73)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, node: &mut Expr) {
[74](#74)        let ignore_return_value = self.ignore_return_value;
[75](#75)        if !matches!(node, Expr::Paren(..) | Expr::Seq(..)) {
[76](#76)            self.ignore_return_value = false;
[77](#77)        }
[78](#78)        node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[79](#79)        self.ignore_return_value = ignore_return_value;
[80](#80)
[81](#81)        if let Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[82](#82)            callee: Callee::Super(..),
[83](#83)            ..
[84](#84)        }) = node
[85](#85)        {
[86](#86)            self.injected = true;
[87](#87)
[88](#88)            let super_call = node.take();
[89](#89)            let exprs = self.exprs.clone();
[90](#90)
[91](#91)            let exprs = iter::once(Box::new(super_call)).chain(exprs);
[92](#92)
[93](#93)            *node = if ignore_return_value {
[94](#94)                SeqExpr {
[95](#95)                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[96](#96)                    exprs: exprs.collect(),
[97](#97)                }
[98](#98)                .into()
[99](#99)            } else {
[100](#100)                let array = ArrayLit {
[101](#101)                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[102](#102)                    elems: exprs.map(ExprOrSpread::from).map(Some).collect(),
[103](#103)                };
[104](#104)
[105](#105)                MemberExpr {
[106](#106)                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[107](#107)                    obj: array.into(),
[108](#108)                    prop: ComputedPropName {
[109](#109)                        span: DUMMY_SP,
[110](#110)                        expr: 0.into(),
[111](#111)                    }
[112](#112)                    .into(),
[113](#113)                }
[114](#114)                .into()
[115](#115)            }
[116](#116)        }
[117](#117)    }
[118](#118)}

[69](#69)#[cfg(feature = "concurrent")]
[70](#70)impl<T> ParallelExt for T
[71](#71)where
[72](#72)    T: Parallel,
[73](#73){
[74](#74)    fn maybe_par_idx_raw<I, F>(&mut self, threshold: usize, nodes: I, op: &F)
[75](#75)    where
[76](#76)        I: Items,
[77](#77)        F: Send + Sync + Fn(&mut Self, usize, I::Elem),
[78](#78)    {
[79](#79)        if nodes.len() >= threshold {
[80](#80)            GLOBALS.with(|globals| {
[81](#81)                let len = nodes.len();
[82](#82)                if len == 0 {
[83](#83)                    return;
[84](#84)                }
[85](#85)
[86](#86)                if len == 1 {
[87](#87)                    op(self, 0, nodes.into_iter().next().unwrap());
[88](#88)                    return;
[89](#89)                }
[90](#90)
[91](#91)                let (na, nb) = nodes.split_at(len / 2);
[92](#92)                let mut vb = Parallel::create(&*self);
[93](#93)
[94](#94)                let (_, vb) = join(
[95](#95)                    || {
[96](#96)                        GLOBALS.set(globals, || {
[97](#97)                            self.maybe_par_idx_raw(threshold, na, op);
[98](#98)                        })
[99](#99)                    },
[100](#100)                    || {
[101](#101)                        GLOBALS.set(globals, || {
[102](#102)                            vb.maybe_par_idx_raw(threshold, nb, op);
[103](#103)
[104](#104)                            vb
[105](#105)                        })
[106](#106)                    },
[107](#107)                );
[108](#108)
[109](#109)                Parallel::merge(self, vb);
[110](#110)            });
[111](#111)
[112](#112)            return;
[113](#113)        }
[114](#114)
[115](#115)        for (idx, n) in nodes.into_iter().enumerate() {
[116](#116)            op(self, idx, n);
[117](#117)        }
[118](#118)    }
[119](#119)}

[53](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#53)pub fn is_irregular_whitespace(c: char) -> bool {
[54](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#54)    matches!(
[55](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#55)        c,
[56](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#56)        | VT
[57](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#57)        | FF
[58](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#58)        | NBSP
[59](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#59)        | NEL
[60](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#60)        | OGHAM_SPACE_MARK
[61](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#61)        | EN_QUAD..=ZWSP
[62](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#62)        | NNBSP
[63](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#63)        | MMSP
[64](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#64)        | IDEOGRAPHIC_SPACE
[65](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#65)        | ZWNBSP
[66](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#66)    )
[67](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#67)}
[68](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#68)
[69](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#69)// https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/blob/9e20e032effad965567d4a1e1c30d5433b0a3332/src/compiler/scanner.ts#L557-L572
[70](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#70)pub fn is_white_space_single_line(c: char) -> bool {
[71](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#71)    // Note: nextLine is in the Zs space, and should be considered to be a
[72](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#72)    // whitespace.
[73](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#73)    // It is explicitly not a line-break as it isn't in the exact set specified by
[74](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#74)    // EcmaScript.
[75](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#75)    matches!(c, SP | TAB) || is_irregular_whitespace(c)
[76](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#76)}
[77](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#77)

[7](#7)pub const fn code_point_to_pair(code_point: u32) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
[8](#8)    if code_point < 0x10000 || code_point > 0x10_ffff {
[9](#9)        None
[10](#10)    } else {
[11](#11)        let adjusted = code_point - 0x10000;
[12](#12)        let high = 0xd800 + (adjusted >> 10);
[13](#13)        let low = 0xdc00 + (adjusted & 0x3ff);
[14](#14)        Some((high, low))
[15](#15)    }
[16](#16)}
[17](#17)
[18](#18)#[inline]
[26](#26)pub const fn pair_to_code_point(high: u32, low: u32) -> u32 {
[27](#27)    (high - 0xd800) * 0x400 + low - 0xdc00 + 0x10000
[28](#28)}
[29](#29)
[30](#30)#[inline]

[34](#34)}
[35](#35)
[36](#36)#[inline]
[38](#38)pub fn is_low_surrogate(u: u32) -> bool {
[39](#39)    (0xdc00..=0xdfff).contains(&u)
[40](#40)}

[50](#50)            unreachable!()
[51](#51)        };
[52](#52)        assert_eq!(high, 0xd83d);
[53](#53)        assert_eq!(low, 0xdca9);
[54](#54)
[55](#55)        assert_eq!(code_point_to_pair(0x1234), None);
[57](#57)    }
[58](#58)
[59](#59)    #[test]
[60](#60)    fn test_roundtrip() {
[61](#61)        let original = 0x1f4a9;
[62](#62)        let Some((high, low)) = code_point_to_pair(original) else {
[63](#63)            unreachable!()
[64](#64)        };
[65](#65)        if low != 0 {
[66](#66)            let recovered = pair_to_code_point(high, low);
[67](#67)            assert_eq!(original, recovered);
[68](#68)        }
[69](#69)    }

[329](#329)                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[330](#330)                    exprs: vec![0f64.into(), self.tag.take()],
[331](#331)                }
[332](#332)                .into(),
[333](#333)            ),
[334](#334)            ..self
[335](#335)        }
[336](#336)    }
[337](#337)}
[338](#338)

[344](#344)            function: self.into(),
[345](#345)        }

[354](#354)        }

[75](#75)    pub fn to_decl(self) -> Vec<VarDeclarator> {
[76](#76)        let Self {
[77](#77)            this,
[78](#78)            args,

[82](#82)            super_update,
[83](#83)            ..
[84](#84)        } = self;
[85](#85)
[86](#86)        let mut decls = Vec::with_capacity(3);
[87](#87)        if let Some(this_id) = this {
[88](#88)            decls.push(VarDeclarator {
[89](#89)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[90](#90)                name: this_id.into(),
[91](#91)                init: Some(ThisExpr { span: DUMMY_SP }.into()),
[92](#92)                definite: false,
[93](#93)            });

[96](#96)            decls.push(VarDeclarator {
[97](#97)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[98](#98)                name: id.into(),
[99](#99)                init: Some(Ident::new_no_ctxt(atom!("arguments"), DUMMY_SP).into()),
[100](#100)                definite: false,
[101](#101)            });
[102](#102)        }
[103](#103)        if let Some(id) = new_target {
[104](#104)            decls.push(VarDeclarator {
[105](#105)                span: DUMMY_SP,
[106](#106)                name: id.into(),
[107](#107)                init: Some(
[108](#108)                    MetaPropExpr {
[109](#109)                        span: DUMMY_SP,
[110](#110)                        kind: MetaPropKind::NewTarget,
[111](#111)                    }
[112](#112)                    .into(),
[113](#113)                ),
[114](#114)                definite: false,
[115](#115)            });
[116](#116)        }
[117](#117)        extend_super(&mut decls, super_get, super_set, super_update);

[119](#119)    }

[244](#244)    fn super_update(&mut self, prop_name: &Atom, prop_span: Span) -> Ident {

[249](#249)                .ident
[250](#250)                .entry(prop_name.clone())

[252](#252)                    private_ident!(prop_span, format!("_superprop_get_{}", prop_name))

[256](#256)                .ident

[260](#260)                });
[261](#261)
[262](#262)            let ident = private_ident!(prop_span, format!("_superprop_update_{}", prop_name));
[263](#263)            self.super_update
[264](#264)                .ident
[265](#265)                .insert(prop_name.clone(), ident.clone());
[266](#266)            ident
[267](#267)        }

[284](#284)impl VisitMut for FnEnvHoister {

[286](#286)
[287](#287)    fn visit_mut_assign_target_pat(&mut self, n: &mut AssignTargetPat) {
[288](#288)        let in_pat = self.in_pat;
[289](#289)        self.in_pat = true;
[290](#290)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[291](#291)        self.in_pat = in_pat;
[292](#292)    }
[293](#293)
[294](#294)    fn visit_mut_block_stmt(&mut self, b: &mut BlockStmt) {
[295](#295)        b.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[296](#296)
[297](#297)        if !self.extra_ident.is_empty() {
[299](#299)            b.stmts.insert(
[300](#300)                0,
[301](#301)                VarDecl {
[302](#302)                    kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[303](#303)                    decls: self
[304](#304)                        .extra_ident
[305](#305)                        .take()
[306](#306)                        .into_iter()
[307](#307)                        .map(|ident| VarDeclarator {
[308](#308)                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[309](#309)                            name: ident.into(),
[310](#310)                            init: None,
[311](#311)                            definite: false,
[312](#312)                        })
[313](#313)                        .collect(),
[314](#314)                    ..Default::default()
[315](#315)                }
[316](#316)                .into(),
[317](#317)            )
[318](#318)        }
[319](#319)    }
[320](#320)
[321](#321)    fn visit_mut_block_stmt_or_expr(&mut self, b: &mut BlockStmtOrExpr) {
[322](#322)        b.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[323](#323)
[324](#324)        if !self.extra_ident.is_empty() {
[326](#326)            if let BlockStmtOrExpr::Expr(e) = b {
[327](#327)                *b = BlockStmtOrExpr::BlockStmt(BlockStmt {
[328](#328)                    stmts: vec![
[329](#329)                        Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(Box::new(VarDecl {
[330](#330)                            kind: VarDeclKind::Var,
[331](#331)                            decls: self
[332](#332)                                .extra_ident
[333](#333)                                .take()
[334](#334)                                .into_iter()
[335](#335)                                .map(|ident| VarDeclarator {
[336](#336)                                    span: DUMMY_SP,
[337](#337)                                    name: ident.into(),
[338](#338)                                    init: None,
[339](#339)                                    definite: false,
[340](#340)                                })
[341](#341)                                .collect(),
[342](#342)                            ..Default::default()
[343](#343)                        }))),
[344](#344)                        Stmt::Return(ReturnStmt {
[345](#345)                            span: e.span(),
[346](#346)                            arg: Some(e.take()),
[347](#347)                        }),
[348](#348)                    ],
[349](#349)                    ..Default::default()
[350](#350)                })
[351](#351)            }
[352](#352)        }
[353](#353)    }
[354](#354)
[355](#355)    fn visit_mut_class(&mut self, _: &mut Class) {}
[357](#357)
[358](#358)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, e: &mut Expr) {
[359](#359)        match e {
[360](#360)            Expr::Ident(Ident { ctxt, sym, .. })
[361](#361)                if !self.arguments_disabled
[362](#362)                    && *sym == "arguments"
[363](#363)                    && (*ctxt == self.unresolved_ctxt || *ctxt == SyntaxContext::empty()) =>
[364](#364)            {
[365](#365)                let arguments = self
[366](#366)                    .args
[367](#367)                    .get_or_insert_with(|| private_ident!("_arguments"));
[368](#368)                *e = arguments.clone().into();
[369](#369)            }
[370](#370)            Expr::This(..) if !self.this_disabled => {
[371](#371)                let this = self.get_this();
[372](#372)                *e = this.into();
[373](#373)            }
[374](#374)            Expr::MetaProp(MetaPropExpr {
[375](#375)                kind: MetaPropKind::NewTarget,
[376](#376)                ..
[377](#377)            }) => {
[378](#378)                let target = self
[379](#379)                    .new_target
[380](#380)                    .get_or_insert_with(|| private_ident!("_newtarget"));
[381](#381)                *e = target.clone().into();
[382](#382)            }
[383](#383)            Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[385](#385)                left,
[386](#386)                right,
[387](#387)                span,
[388](#388)                op,
[389](#389)            }) => {
[390](#390)                let expr = match left {
[391](#391)                    AssignTarget::Simple(e) => e,
[392](#392)                    AssignTarget::Pat(..) => {
[393](#393)                        e.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[394](#394)                        return;
[395](#395)                    }
[396](#396)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[397](#397)                    _ => return,
[398](#398)                };
[399](#399)                if !self.super_disabled {
[400](#400)                    if let SimpleAssignTarget::SuperProp(super_prop) = &mut *expr {
[401](#401)                        let left_span = super_prop.span;
[402](#402)                        match &mut super_prop.prop {
[403](#403)                            SuperProp::Computed(c) => {
[404](#404)                                let callee = self.super_set_computed(left_span);
[405](#405)
[406](#406)                                let op = op.to_update();
[407](#407)
[408](#408)                                let args = if let Some(op) = op {
[409](#409)                                    let tmp = private_ident!("tmp");
[410](#410)                                    self.extra_ident.push(tmp.clone());
[411](#411)                                    vec![
[412](#412)                                        Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[413](#413)                                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[414](#414)                                            left: tmp.clone().into(),
[415](#415)                                            op: op!("="),
[416](#416)                                            right: c.expr.take(),
[417](#417)                                        })
[418](#418)                                        .as_arg(),
[419](#419)                                        Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[420](#420)                                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[421](#421)                                            left: Box::new(Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[422](#422)                                                span: DUMMY_SP,
[423](#423)                                                callee: self
[424](#424)                                                    .super_get_computed(DUMMY_SP)
[425](#425)                                                    .as_callee(),
[426](#426)                                                args: vec![tmp.as_arg()],
[427](#427)                                                ..Default::default()
[428](#428)                                            })),
[429](#429)                                            op,
[430](#430)                                            right: right.take(),
[431](#431)                                        })
[432](#432)                                        .as_arg(),
[433](#433)                                    ]
[434](#434)                                } else {
[435](#435)                                    vec![c.expr.take().as_arg(), right.take().as_arg()]
[436](#436)                                };
[437](#437)                                *e = CallExpr {
[438](#438)                                    span: *span,
[439](#439)                                    args,
[440](#440)                                    callee: callee.as_callee(),
[441](#441)                                    ..Default::default()
[442](#442)                                }
[443](#443)                                .into();
[444](#444)                            }
[445](#445)                            SuperProp::Ident(id) => {
[446](#446)                                let callee = self.super_set(&id.sym, left_span);
[447](#447)                                *e = CallExpr {
[448](#448)                                    span: *span,
[449](#449)                                    args: vec![(if let Some(op) = op.to_update() {
[450](#450)                                        Box::new(Expr::Bin(BinExpr {
[451](#451)                                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[452](#452)                                            left: Box::new(
[453](#453)                                                self.super_get(&id.sym, id.span)
[454](#454)                                                    .as_call(id.span, Vec::new()),
[455](#455)                                            ),
[456](#456)                                            op,
[457](#457)                                            right: right.take(),
[458](#458)                                        }))
[459](#459)                                    } else {
[460](#460)                                        right.take()
[461](#461)                                    })
[462](#462)                                    .as_arg()],
[463](#463)                                    callee: callee.as_callee(),
[464](#464)                                    ..Default::default()
[465](#465)                                }
[466](#466)                                .into();
[467](#467)                            }
[468](#468)                            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[469](#469)                            _ => (),
[470](#470)                        }
[471](#471)                    }
[472](#472)                }
[473](#473)                e.visit_mut_children_with(self)
[474](#474)            }
[475](#475)            Expr::Call(CallExpr {
[477](#477)                span,
[478](#478)                callee: Callee::Expr(expr),
[479](#479)                args,
[480](#480)                ..
[481](#481)            }) => {
[482](#482)                if !self.super_disabled {
[483](#483)                    if let Expr::SuperProp(super_prop) = &mut **expr {
[484](#484)                        match &mut super_prop.prop {
[485](#485)                            SuperProp::Computed(c) => {
[486](#486)                                let callee = self.super_get_computed(super_prop.span);
[487](#487)                                let call: Expr = CallExpr {
[488](#488)                                    span: *span,
[489](#489)                                    args: vec![c.expr.take().as_arg()],
[490](#490)                                    callee: callee.as_callee(),
[491](#491)                                    ..Default::default()
[492](#492)                                }
[493](#493)                                .into();
[494](#494)                                let mut new_args = args.take();
[495](#495)
[496](#496)                                new_args.insert(0, self.get_this().as_arg());
[497](#497)
[498](#498)                                *e = call.call_fn(*span, new_args);
[499](#499)                            }
[500](#500)                            SuperProp::Ident(id) => {
[501](#501)                                let callee = self.super_get(&id.sym, super_prop.span);
[502](#502)                                let call: Expr = CallExpr {
[503](#503)                                    span: *span,
[504](#504)                                    args: Vec::new(),
[505](#505)                                    callee: callee.as_callee(),
[506](#506)                                    ..Default::default()
[507](#507)                                }
[508](#508)                                .into();
[509](#509)                                let mut new_args = args.take();
[510](#510)
[511](#511)                                new_args.insert(0, self.get_this().as_arg());
[512](#512)
[513](#513)                                *e = call.call_fn(*span, new_args);
[514](#514)                            }
[515](#515)                            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[516](#516)                            _ => (),
[517](#517)                        }
[518](#518)                    };
[519](#519)                }
[520](#520)                e.visit_mut_children_with(self)
[521](#521)            }
[522](#522)            Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { arg, .. }) if arg.is_super_prop() => {
[524](#524)                let in_pat = self.in_pat;
[525](#525)                self.in_pat = true;
[527](#527)                arg.visit_mut_with(self);
[528](#528)                self.in_pat = in_pat;
[529](#529)            }
[530](#530)            Expr::SuperProp(SuperPropExpr { prop, span, .. }) if !self.super_disabled => match prop
[531](#531)            {
[532](#532)                SuperProp::Computed(c) => {
[533](#533)                    c.expr.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[534](#534)                    *e = if self.in_pat {
[535](#535)                        Expr::from(CallExpr {
[536](#536)                            span: *span,
[537](#537)                            args: vec![c.expr.take().as_arg()],
[538](#538)                            callee: self.super_update_computed(*span).as_callee(),
[539](#539)                            ..Default::default()
[540](#540)                        })
[541](#541)                        .make_member(atom!("_").into())
[542](#542)                        .into()
[543](#543)                    } else {
[544](#544)                        CallExpr {
[545](#545)                            span: *span,
[546](#546)                            args: vec![c.expr.take().as_arg()],
[547](#547)                            callee: self.super_get_computed(*span).as_callee(),
[548](#548)                            ..Default::default()
[549](#549)                        }
[550](#550)                        .into()
[551](#551)                    };
[552](#552)                }
[553](#553)                SuperProp::Ident(id) => {
[554](#554)                    *e = if self.in_pat {
[555](#555)                        self.super_update(&id.sym, *span)
[556](#556)                            .make_member(quote_ident!("_"))
[557](#557)                            .into()
[558](#558)                    } else {
[559](#559)                        CallExpr {
[560](#560)                            span: *span,
[561](#561)                            args: Vec::new(),
[562](#562)                            callee: self.super_get(&id.sym, *span).as_callee(),
[563](#563)                            ..Default::default()
[564](#564)                        }
[565](#565)                        .into()
[566](#566)                    };
[567](#567)                }
[568](#568)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[569](#569)                _ => (),
[570](#570)            },
[571](#571)            _ => e.visit_mut_children_with(self),
[572](#572)        }
[573](#573)    }
[574](#574)
[575](#575)    fn visit_mut_function(&mut self, _: &mut Function) {}
[577](#577)
[578](#578)    fn visit_mut_getter_prop(&mut self, p: &mut GetterProp) {
[580](#580)        if p.key.is_computed() {
[581](#581)            p.key.visit_mut_with(self);
[582](#582)        }
[583](#583)    }
[584](#584)
[585](#585)    fn visit_mut_method_prop(&mut self, p: &mut MethodProp) {
[586](#586)        if p.key.is_computed() {
[587](#587)            p.key.visit_mut_with(self);
[588](#588)        }
[589](#589)    }
[590](#590)
[591](#591)    fn visit_mut_pat(&mut self, n: &mut Pat) {
[592](#592)        let in_pat = self.in_pat;
[593](#593)        self.in_pat = true;
[594](#594)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[595](#595)        self.in_pat = in_pat;
[596](#596)    }
[597](#597)
[598](#598)    fn visit_mut_setter_prop(&mut self, p: &mut SetterProp) {
[599](#599)        if p.key.is_computed() {
[600](#600)            p.key.visit_mut_with(self);
[601](#601)        }
[602](#602)    }
[603](#603)}

[605](#605)pub fn init_this(stmts: &mut Vec<Stmt>, this_id: &Ident) {
[606](#606)    stmts.visit_mut_children_with(&mut InitThis { this_id })
[607](#607)}
[608](#608)
[609](#609)struct InitThis<'a> {
[610](#610)    this_id: &'a Ident,
[611](#611)}
[612](#612)
[613](#613)impl VisitMut for InitThis<'_> {
[615](#615)    noop_visit_mut_type!(fail);
[616](#616)
[617](#617)    fn visit_mut_class(&mut self, _: &mut Class) {}
[618](#618)
[619](#619)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, expr: &mut Expr) {
[624](#624)        expr.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[625](#625)
[626](#626)        if let Expr::Call(
[627](#627)            call_expr @ CallExpr {
[628](#628)                callee: Callee::Super(..),
[629](#629)                ..
[630](#630)            },
[631](#631)        ) = expr
[632](#632)        {
[633](#633)            let span = call_expr.span;
[634](#634)            *expr = ParenExpr {
[635](#635)                span,
[636](#636)                expr: SeqExpr {
[637](#637)                    span,
[638](#638)                    exprs: vec![
[639](#639)                        Box::new(Expr::Call(call_expr.take())),
[640](#640)                        Box::new(Expr::Assign(AssignExpr {
[641](#641)                            span: DUMMY_SP,
[642](#642)                            left: self.this_id.clone().into(),
[643](#643)                            op: AssignOp::Assign,
[644](#644)                            right: Box::new(Expr::This(ThisExpr { span: DUMMY_SP })),
[645](#645)                        })),
[646](#646)                    ],
[647](#647)                }
[648](#648)                .into(),
[649](#649)            }
[650](#650)            .into()
[651](#651)        }
[652](#652)    }
[653](#653)}
